The results obtained show that EAMMH protocol outperforms LEACH-C in every scenario.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Based Facial Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Facial recognition has become an important factor in our life because of its usage in various applications. These applications include unlocking smartphones, smart advertising, prevent retail crimes; tracking school attendance, recognizing important dignitaries at events, find missing persons and others. Apart from its uses, it also has various challenges to encounter such as different poses, background, noise, illumination and others. We have various Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models and learning methods employed which gives optimal results. These models have various layers in them which extract important information from the input image, reduce dimensionality and pass this information to further layers. This paper focuses on two aspects facial detection and classification using deep learning. The work proposes a deep learning model to capture these aspects. Experimentation takes images from the database, applies Image Generator for Augmentation, trains the model for a certain number of epochs where the model adjusts its weights using backpropagation to give better accuracy. Performance evaluation of the model shows that it has been successful in predicting the faces of individuals correctly with an accuracy of 89%.

articleTitle: Backstepping based Trajectory Tracking Control of a Class of Reconfigurable Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Reconfigurable robots are a type of robots, which can change their morphology during operation. The extra capacity to change configuration, make them suitable for numerous engineering applications like cleaning, spacecraft maintenance, surveillance etc. As the configuration of these robots can change in between operations, the mathematical model also changes abruptly. This in turn give rise to modelling uncertainties, which can impact the closed loop performance, if not taken care of. Backstepping technique is an efficient design procedure for rigorously stabilizing and controlling strict feedback nonlinear systems that finds many applications in fields like process control, automation, robotics, the aerospace industry and other real-world disciplines. This work offers a robust backstepping controller architecture for a class of reconfigurable mobile robots that use differential drive technology to operate. The suggested method's utility is proven in a simulated scenario.

articleTitle: Predicting Depression from Social Networking Data using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this era of COVID-19 pandemic, as more people self-isolate themselves, psychological health issues like depression, anxiety, and stress is an increasing concern all over the world. The purpose of this study is to investigate the data from social forums, where we found communities of depressed people sharing their thoughts and emotions in the forums, these forums also receive advices and support. In this paper, we will analyse the "depressed" text; by manipulating the data, extracting features, categorising, and try to understand what are the attributes of "depressed" text, and how we can "predict" whether a text should be marked as depressed or not. Using text analysis and text data mining techniques, the text obtained from the social forums was analysed and three different machine learning algorithms were used to predict depression. After cross validation overall accuracy of 99.69% was obtained as the best score using the proposed system. This study definitively answers the question regarding using human basic language and communication of personal experiences, for the prediction of depression and can be reached easily. Furthermore, not only actions, habits and behaviour of a person, text too can be used for accurate diagnosis of depression.

articleTitle: Implementation of Smart Monitoring System in Vertical Farming by using NodeMCU
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: There are plenty of ways are existing for the precise farming through analyzing and regulating the environmental variables. Because of insufficient sunlight, moisture and heat, plants will be adversely affected. Therefore, it is important to find a way to accurately analyze the parameters. In this paper, we have analyzed and established the recommended system centered on the constraint in the present-day supervising system. A great resolution to this challenge is to produce a hot air heat in accordance with the required conditions. Large areas covered by networks will help us in this issue. We have developed an automated temperature and sunlight monitoring system by using different sensors and controls some actuators and maintains the optimum conditions.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Threats And Their Solutions Through Deep Learning: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays a major concern in the field of information technology is Cyber security. Although in the recent times there have been booming advancements in the field of technology, but it has also brought along various risks including malware attacks, cloud abuse hacking, insecure API, cyber scams, data breach and so on. Because cyber-attacks are convenient, cheap and involves less risks, these are the reasons that they go on multiplying [32]. A cybercriminal only needs a few expenses in addition to a computer and an active internet connection. There are no other constraints such as geography and distance[1]. Therefore, to tackle the increasing menace of cybercrimes, researchers have started their work on cyber security making it the most promising field of study. Therefore, in today’s world of business, cybersecurity has become an urgent need. Understanding this need, deep learning methods are being used by cybersecurity experts for dealing with various problems foisted by the cyber criminals[2]. This paper reviews various threats in the path of cyber security and it also brings to light various deep learning methods that have been employed to combat with these threats.

articleTitle: Prediction of Pulmonary Fibrosis Progression using CNN and Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The term idiopathic is used to refer to disease caused by unknown causes. Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is a chronic, progressive disease which affects the lungs and causes scar tissues to develop within them. This prevents the patient’s lungs to transport oxygen into the bloodstream effectively. The daily routine of the patient is affected as the ease of breathing continues to decline. Early medical intervention and proper diagnosis can help keep the disease under control. The severity of the disease is measured used Forced Vital Capacity (FVC) values. In this paper we design an easy-to-use web application which collects the patient’s CT scans, characteristic data and the initial FVC measurement. We predict the FVC values for up to a period of 2.5-3.0 years which effectively provides the Pulmonologist the rate of decline upon which suitable medications can be provided to stall the decline. We use Regression Techniques and CNN architectures to predict FVC values.

articleTitle: 3D Asset Size Reduction using Mesh Retopology and Normal Texture Mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: There has been a discerning trend over the past few years that increasingly, games have become more and more graphically immersive. A considerable part of this is due to the shift in trend towards photo-realism. This high detail look is often the main selling point of many video games. Such highly detailed work draws in the player’s attention and makes the game more immersive than ever. However, this also brings in some associated problems like increased asset size, loading and rendering time. Many games load in low detailed models and, based on the player’s field of view and rendering distance, change the level of detail. These games do this to overcome the increased render time and GPU load large size assets have. This paper aims to present a new method to generate a singular 3D model with high enough details and small asset size, eliminating the requirement of constantly switching between the low and high detailed versions of 3D models. The presented approach addresses switching between objects by retopologising the meshes and baking the textures directly onto a singular 3D model, thus reducing the geometry while maintaining the details. When applied to photo scanned 3D models or designer made high poly models, this technique not only preserves the original details of the models but also drastically reduces the asset size. This, in turn, reduces the rendering and loading time. The technique applies to large scale game projects and competitive online games, where loading times and rendering objects at higher distances (without compromising the LOD) are of utmost importance.

articleTitle: Early- Detection of Parkinson’s Disease by Patient Voice Modulation Analysis through MFCC Feature Extraction Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The present study aims to develop the evaluation of Parkinson’s disorder based on changes in speech disorders. So we proposed a diagnostic system based on vocal disorders by detecting the extraction of vocal characteristics (speech). In this study, the subjects that voice signals used to allow the computer to decide whether the person is affected by the disease or not. We have collected the voice sample of affected patients with Parkinson’s disease and subsequently extracted from 1 to 22 Mel’s frequency cepstral coefficient for each patient. Then we compress the frame signals by identifying the average value then, able to identify if the patient is caused by Parkinson’s disease or not. It can be used in the hospital for a preliminary examination of a certain disease that occurs in the central nervous system only under the supervision of a physician in a controlled environment. This method is easy to handle, fast, non-invasive for the patients, and affordable for healthcare professionals. It is used to reduce time and human resource consumption.

articleTitle: Systematic review on the smart energy transmission through "SMART GRID" - An application of IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Electricity transmission is the necessity of any civilization for today's era. This is the major energy source for households, businesses, and other organizations and groups. The traditional transmission is done through a system called a power grid. But, there are limitations of the conventional power grid. Power Grid is actually an ecosystem or integrated framework of the manufacturer, government officials, and assets and service providers at the country level and governs and manages at the Federal, state, and local levels. All the stakeholders are working together to execute and run one of the most consistent electrical grids in the world. The conventional power grid is only able for the unidirectional power supply but the "Smart grid" technologies are made possible by both-way communication technologies, computer processing, and control systems. This paper is explaining the need for the smart grid along with its components and functionalities. The analysis has been incorporated which is able to explain the working and research in this field so far.

articleTitle: Making Toll Charges Collection Efficient and Trustless: A Blockchain-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The paper attempted to combine the road toll charges collection systems and blockchain technology to examine how well these two concepts could fit together in terms of better functioning and security. Toll plazas in India have a colossal rush and are always questionable for their service and the actual amount of payment collection. To avoid the hustle and cash payment in the current situation, go for the e-payment system. This will really help to avoid carrying cash amount as well change of money. But the constraints are required internet for the execution of e payment system. In this system, we need trend people, standard procedures for the payment system, and enhanced technologies. An entire financial exchange is based on a bank and its network link. But the bank has a centralized system, and sometimes it is not secure. This research work proposed the toll payment system based on blockchain to provide a safer and manageable system. As the blockchain feature, this proposed model is secure and least chance to temple the data. In the working process of this system, we use mobile to read QR codes at the toll plaza for the payment. The system uses a smart contract to pay as per the traveling distance covered by the vehicle, and every toll system has a record of these transactions.

articleTitle: Segmenting Mall Customers Data to Improve Business into Higher Target using K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Every day we deal with a vast amount of data. To analyze those data is such a big task but also important. This paper demonstrates the segmentation of customers of e-commerce website based on a machine learning algorithm namely K-Means Clustering. We have collected the data of around 300 customers from an e-commerce website and their total yearly pay on an e-commerce website and then we will analyze it and found the number of optimum clusters. Now a day’s every company is targeting their customers based on the available data and trying to find out the behaviors of customers like which kind of product most attracting them, what they like. Based on that customer’s behavior companies are launching their new products. We will use the K-Means Clustering Algorithm a machine learning-based method to find the optimum number of clusters and analyze the underlying client segments supported by the information provided. In today’s world, it is hard to get the customers behavior and categorizing the customers into different clusters and categories’ customers supported their human ecology and shopping for behavior. This could be a crucial side of client partition that permits the business to higher target their customers increase in selling’s and modify their products according to their targeted customers and launching new products.

articleTitle: 5G Antenna at Millimeter Wave Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Designing compact antennas operating at 5G millimeter wave bands is an emerging research area in the era of wireless communication. This research paper presents the designing, simulation as well as measurement of microstrip patch antenna functioning at 28 GHz. The proposed antenna has dimensions of 12 x 15 x 0.508 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and is resonating at 28 GHz with measured reflection co-efficient of -17.05 dB, bandwidth of 1.23 GHz and gain of 7.4 dB. The measurement results demonstrate the suitability of the proposed design for 5G wireless applications at millimeter wave band.

articleTitle: Construction Cost Estimator: An effective approach to estimate the cost of Construction in Metropolitan Areas
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Individuals wanting to buy a modern home tend to be more traditionalists in terms of their finances and presentation methods. The current framework incorporates housing cost calculations without a basic projection of future advertising trends and cost increases. Buyers will like the actual bequest structure since it allows them to search for properties based on features or addresses. It is beneficial to the dealer since it allows them to log into the framework and add new promos or delete old ones. Each customer is given a login account with a login ID and password for this purpose. Additionally, when the customer searches for a property, the client will see both unique and predicted property values. Future costs will be predicted by analysing historical market patterns and price ranges, as well as up and coming advances. Estimating construction costs and anticipating fee increases are critical tasks for project owners, estimators, and contractors. The creation prices are continually susceptible to changes, with a long-term tendency toward growing, making pricing a tough task. The creation value index has been widely used to estimate the price of new ventures. The issue is that no agency in India gives estimates for that crucial indicator [21]. The most important value of this finding is that it provides construction stakeholders with a reliable tool for forecasting future project pricing, especially given current Inflation Rates.

articleTitle: Parametric Extraction and Comparison of Different Voltage-Mode based Sense Amplifier Topologies
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sense amplifiers plays vital role in sensing the stored data in the memory core. Sense amplifier also helps in reducing overall sensing voltage and delay and effects theoverall power consumption for a memory block. So, it is important to study various sense amplifiers for better performance. This paper focuses on design and performance comparison of various sense amplifier designs. The sense amplifier is analyzed for energy, current, delay and power consumption. The paper also reports the comparative analysis between the various cross coupled voltage mode sense amplifiers and transmission gate voltage mode sense amplifier. The result shows the performance of transmission gate sense amplifier is better in case of energy power and current parameters. All the simulations done using LT spice at 180nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Devanagari Character Recognition using Deep Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the presented paper, a Deep Learning architecture for Devanagari handwritten character recognition is introduced. The dataset comprises of 94742 images of 58 distinct classes containing numerals, vowels and consonants from Devanagari script. Deep Convolution Neural Network (DCNN) have indicated better outcomes than traditional Machine Learning algorithms and Shallow networks in recognition tasks. The proposed algorithm achieved an accuracy of 99.20% on testing data with 98.31% accuracy on training data.

articleTitle: Web-Page Interfaced Real-Time Object Detection Using TensorFlow
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Technology has improved fast in recent years. With the development of the powerful microprocessor and good quality camera technologies like artificial intelligence and computer vision making significant strives in modern times. Computer vision-based real-time object detection helps detect, locate, and trace an object from an image or a video with the use of these technologies. This paper proposes a method to interface this real-time system into a web page. To detect objects the TensorFlow object detection API is used and live video is streamed through a password-protected login web page which can be accessed from any device. The system creates a bounding box around the object and also shows the detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Personality Prediction and Analysis using Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper, K-means clustering is used to analyze human personality. Questionnaires are created by using International Personality Item Pool's public domain collection (IPIP) to collect dataset by creating a Google form. There exists some previous research work based on machine learning methods to predict human personality types. Only a handful of them, however, have good results. Data collection, data optimization, and parameter modification are the three components used in this study. As a consequence, the information is divided into five groups (OCEAN), which we refer to as personality types. In this paper, people with similar personalities are grouped together based on ocean personality model.

articleTitle: Automatic Finite Deterministic Algorithm and PSO Based Secured Energy Efficient Routing in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Economic sensor networks have always been a boon to disaster management applications due to their ease of setup. Communication is difficult for them due of their vulnerability to a variety of security dangers. This study presents a new routing strategy those guards against both external and internal threats such as hello flooding, eavesdropping, and wormhole attacks. To limit energy dissipation, this method employs a one-way hash chain. Event-driven clustering at the level also saves energy. The suggested technique extends network longevity even when the cluster-based wireless sensor network is under attack, according to simulated results. A 5G wireless sensor network (WSN) is a collection of self-contained nodes that monitor the environment. WSN design goals like as energy efficiency or secure data transmission are primarily measured. With the increasing difficulties of workstation networks, network-based attacks have drawn the attention of various academics from various domains. As a result, multiple intrusion detection systems (IDS) have been built to address various areas of complicated security, such as denial-of-service attacks, worms, viruses, malware, and so on. IDS automation has been designed to safely restore the realization of energy-efficient routing in wireless sensor networks. Intrusion detection and data transmission performed in a secure manner using automatic finite deterministic and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms that determine and follow an optimum path. Routing along the optimal path can restore the overall appearance of a sensor network in wireless technology, and it can be managed using a variety of indicators (such as power expenditure, capacity, network life, active nodes and dead nodes). The threat model and safety objectives for secure routing in wireless networks are discussed in this paper. The simulation was carried out using the MATLAB simulation software.

articleTitle: Power Management on A Fuzzy Base Small Scale Microgrid Based on Hybrid Wind and Solar Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A small-scale hybrid wind-solar-battery microgrid’s energy management system is proposed in this study. To verify the function of the proposed hybrid micro grid, control algorithms, power electronic converters and controllers are designed, as well as needed control algorithms, power electronic converters and controllers. This tiny grid is self-contained and serves as a trial ground for various energy management system and control algorithm. An energy management system is developed based on fuzzy logic technique.

articleTitle: A Survey on Formal Specification of Security Requirements
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Formalization of security requirements ensures the correctness of any safety-critical system, software system, and web applications through specification and verification. Although there is a gap between security requirements expressed in natural language and formal language. Formal language is a more powerful tool based on higher-order mathematics to express unambiguous and concise security requirements.it remains an active research challenge to express precise, concrete, and correct security requirements. Identification of security requirements is also a challenging task because requirement inherent in the software changes frequently. Specification through formal methods is possible only after fixing the security requirements. In this study, we propose a formal specification software process model (FSSPM). The proposed model indicates the use of formal specification at the early phase of software development is cost-effective, time saving, and reduces the possibility of error at the later phase of software development.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Deep Fake Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Recent developments and evolutions in machine learning algorithms have directed to the emergence of first-class altered pictures that create video frames and have a striking similarity to real-world pictures that create video frames. This can have a disastrous effect on how people perceive digitally available knowledge or facts. Recent developments in machine learning and camera function have allowed pictures that compose video frames and sounds to be convincingly altered. These deep-fake films differ from actual videos by replacing the soundtrack, the lip movement, or the location where the video was captured (background). Many relevant tools and automated systems for detecting such deep fake films have been developed. Researchers employ techniques such as pose estimation, facial artefacts, temporal pattern analysis, background comparison, eye blinking, and mesoscopic analysis. In a unique statistical research, we want to present a descriptive review of these traditional deep Fake detection approaches.

articleTitle: Recommender Systems in E-commerce and their Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the advancement in technology and the usage of internet, everything is just a click away from purchasing. It can be online shopping, banking, communicating or even watching movies. Many large e-commerce websites like Amazon and Netflix have already incorporated recommender systems to increase their sales. The competition for providing the best products and services is evident between e-commerce websites. In this paper we have discussed about the common recommendation techniques that are being used in the electronic commerce industry to help customize recommendations. We also discuss ways in which the recommender system enhances the e-commerce business. The paper has also thrown light on the prominent issues and challenges the system faces which includes sparsity and latency. It also proposes areas in which the recommender system needs to be improved so as to give optimal suggestions and tackle with the problems of future.

articleTitle: Text Summarization using Extractive Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Text Summarization is an indirect way of contracting the given content into more simple words while saving its information and importance. It is hard for individuals to sum up huge reports physically. Text summarization strategy mainly consists of removal of unwanted repeated matter and making it as precise as possible without losing its core concept. In this venture, we have applied three extractive outline strategies to be specific: term frequency inward document frequency (TF-IDF), text rank calculation, and latent semantic analysis (LSA). In this work, an exhaustive survey of extractive book synopsis measure strategies has been determined. Rouge-N metric has been utilized to break down and assess the came-about synopsis of the first report. Text Summarization reduces study time. It can be used in question answering systems as it provides personalized information. For certain reports, summarization makes the procedure simpler. Summarizing by the text summarizer is less biased than the human summarizer. It also empowers business theoretical administrations to build the number of content archives they can process. In this paper, the different methods and difficulties of extractive outline have been surveyed. This paper deciphers extractive content synopsis methods with a less excess outline, profoundly cement, intelligent, and profundity data. We have found a moderate methodology for the component extraction of sentences.

articleTitle: Human Centred Software Development Approaches
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Software development engineering is widely used in various organizations to provide functionalities to the end users. The main reason behind the failure of software projects is their incapability to meet the current needs of business and end users. The recent agile software development practices help development teams towards optimal and quality outcomes of the software product. These practices use accretion approach with the main focus on greater communication and relationship between the user level. In our research paper, we have used "Agile based engineering practices and design-thinking technique for develop a human centred software development (HCSD)". Design thinking is a practical and creative way to solve a problem quickly. In this paper we give an upper level of identification and understanding of real time end-users that lead to a human-centred iterative design for developing higher quality software products used by agile and design thinking software approaches.

articleTitle: A Regression Based Approach To Predict The Indian Stock Market Trend Amid COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Corona Virus Disease (COVID-19) has triggered a global disaster by affecting over 200 countries in a short period of time. It has had a significant impact on both social and economic activities all over the world. Panic selling has been prompted by investors' herd behaviour. As a result, stock markets worldwide have plummeted. The market data is nonlinear and chaotic. Predicting the behaviour of the market in current circumstances is a challenging task.. In this work, improved quality of input data and enhanced feature engineering mechanism is adapted to predict the stock market trend amid COVID-19. Here both classical, as well as ensemble regression models are used to investigate the impact of predictors. The models are evaluated using R- squared metric. The findings of this study highlight that the opening price of the market and total positive cases in India significantly impact the closing price of the Nifty50 index. Furthermore, the linear regression model performed better than other models and achieved an R-squared value of 0.999 for both training and test sets.

articleTitle: Bug Report Classification into Orthogonal Defect Classification Defect Type using Long Short Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Software systems are being used in many businesses for performing critical operations such as financial operations. A bug in these systems can lead to financial losses. By identifying the type of such bugs, developers can easily take an action to fix a bug. Orthogonal defect classification model is a popular model for classifying bug reports in various attributes. In this paper, we proposed a bug report classification method that classify into their type as defined by ODC based on long short term memory, a RNN which is used in many classification task. The proposed method outperforms the classical approach such as bag of words and TF-IDF based classification models.

articleTitle: Pitfalls of Conventional MPPT Techniques of Solar PV
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper, the performances of four conventional techniques of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) are evaluated and compared to highlight their shortfalls. The conventional techniques, such as Constant Voltage (CV), Constant Current (CC), Perturb and Observe (P&O) and Incremental Conductance (INC) are considered and their performance are evaluated with the input-output power curves. It is revealed that the P&O technique outperforms the other three.

articleTitle: Multiple Object Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the cutting edge and quick world, finding a precise and proficient object recognition for headway in Computer vision frameworks has been integral part. With the emerge offaster (due to faster and better hardware to) and increasingly accurate deep learning techniques the prediction for finding a good and accurate model has been justified. In this undertaking, we are actually aiming to incorporate best possible technique to tackle object detection with goal of achieving higher accuracy in our Multiple Object Detection project. The major motivation in our task was to making tremendous contribution to increase the accuracy of the object detection. In this venture, we utilize four models to tackle the problem, mainly Mask- RCNN (Mask Region Convolution Neural Network), Faster-RCNN (Faster Region Convolution Neural Network), SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detection) and YOLO (You look only once) trained on the most publicly and freely accessible dataset (MS-COCO).

articleTitle: Arduino Based Smart Security For Home Automation
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent times, smart home automation has become very popular. The research paper is based on creating an Arduino-based smart system for home security. A Smart system for home is needed to provide better security and smart control over home appliances. As life on earth is becoming more dependent on the internet, home automation has become a hot topic and attracted considerable attraction. The objective of this paper is to deliver a extremely scalable also it was multifunctional home automation system at low cost. The advancement in technology has gifted us with cheap micro-controllers like Arduino that is capable of integrating various sensors and appliances which is useful in the implementation process of home automation. Motion Detection Sensor (PIR), Gas Sensor (MQ6), Wooden Sensor (ASR-38B) and Temperature Sensor (DHT11) are used in designing of the system. The information collected by sensors can be accessed by the user regardless of their location over the internet. Results after testing show that the system is working properly.

articleTitle: Categorizing the Heart Syndrome Condition by Predictive Analysis Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As the age of the elderly patients are getting increased, the health factors are also getting affected. By the drastic increase of the human being population, the health factor has to be checked and monitored accordingly. One of the main factors which have to be monitored is the heart rate. Heart rate is said to be the rate of which the heart beat per minute. Heart arrhythmia/ irregular heartbeat can cause heart stroke which causes fatal too. Heart stroke occurs based upon the vibratory state of the heartbeat. If the Heartbeat is mild when compared to the normal heart beat, then the pulse rate is low for the patient. If the Heartbeat is irregular which can vibrate in high stroke then it is strong heart stroke/ severe cardiac arrest where the blood flow is excessive to the artery. Based upon the heart stroke, the range of cardiac arrest can be detected. Blood pressure is also maintained identify the flow of excessive flow. By detecting both the heart rate and blood pressure state, the stroke can be detected. In this novel paper, describe the way of identifying different variations in the heartbeat and blood pressure using machine learning approach. Supervised learning classifies the data in comparative analysis by using SVM, random regression and other techniques. These compares the statistical data of the previous data report by classifying and comparing the data into a statistical report via application.

articleTitle: Survey on Importance of Load Balancing for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing is very demanding technology worldwide to support industrial and academy related applications. Government department, universities and Enterprises move towards cloud computing, it is an extension of IT resources. Cloud Computing provide the facility to store the large number of data on the cloud and can access whenever it required from anywhere. Cloud Computing become very demanding technologyfor web applications, a huge number of users can access web application at a time so the concept of Load Balancer come into picture. In this survey paper we compare and contrast the various load balancing policy.

articleTitle: Emergency Alert System for Neonatal Unit using IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As normal new-born babies, premature new-born babies cannot control their own body temperature. By having an atmosphere that can be changed to provide the optimum temperature as well as the right amount of oxygen, humidity, and light, neonatal incubators play a crucial role in saving premature babies' lives. Owing to a lack of adequate control of the incubator, some premature babies have lost their lives. If an unexpected condition occurs, via an alarm system, it will be signaled to the health professional's mobile device. Early treatment will be provided to the infected babies by alerting them and the chance of recovery will be increased. We concentrated on monitoring the biological parameters for multiple incubators to resolve this problem. And if there are any fluctuations in the biological parameters from the usual standard to be preserved, then the health professionals will be indicated through the blynk application.

articleTitle: PCB Classification using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: For circuit-based applications to run successfully, the Printed Circuit Board (PCB) must be properly functioning, as, a defect in it can be dangerous for electronic circuits. Identification of simple images like fruits, scenery, etc. may be a convenient task for humans, but for images like that of a PCB, minute observation is required. When there is a huge dataset containing a variety of PCB images, it is very difficult for humans to classify the defective and non-defective PCBs. PCB has joint soldering, component placing, connections, etc. which can be the factors for classification. PCB defects can be then identified via model training through Machine Learning (ML). Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model is proposed for classifying the PCB to be defective or not. The model is trained for two classes: defective and non-defective PCB images and then the classification is done as per the PCB faults and parameters. So, if a user wants to separate out defective PCBs from a mixed lot, such an ML-based model can be helpful. The proposed model achieved a detection accuracy of 92.8% for PCB.

articleTitle: Hand-Wash Sanitization Compliance Monitoring CNN Model To Maintain The Hygiene
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s world, with the rise of infectious diseases, proper hand-washing has become essential, particularly in hospitals and breeding grounds for pathogens. However, even in these places, pseudo dirty hand spots remain, which may be a significant vector for nosocomial diseases if proper and effective hand washing does not occur. That is why hand-washing in hospitals needs to be automated to detect hygiene without facing the problem due to skin color and brightness. While most methods deal with hand-wash compliance using video processing or sensors, we propose a Hygiene Maintenance CNN (HMCNN) Model for detecting hand-washing compliance by breaking the video into frames and utilizing transfer learning. The HMCNN model is used to get better results with 93.38% accuracy against tested consistent data than the pre-existing model. The proposed model can check the WHO guidelines for hand-washing and notify the user if it is not done correctly, helping set up a medical sector hand-wash sanitizing monitoring system.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Based Patient and Doctor Virtual Interaction During Pandemic in Rwanda
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Rwanda has made a lot of change in health care systems due to the emergency of pandemics that put a lot of number of people at risks of being infected. Due to the huge number of people looking for health services and a shortage of health infrastructure including a few numbers of trained medicine doctors in developing countries, there are unexpected deaths of people due to the shortage of infrastructures to accommodate a big number of incoming patients [1]. The government of Rwanda confirmed the policy of keeping some of the patients at their home place during their sicknesses (Home based care). However, due to the lack of the real time information about the patients or the individuals at their home place, this can put the many people at the risk of being dead.This paper serves to analyze the performance of the existing wearable devices worldwide and to develop a wearable hardware product that would be used to monitor the patient at their home place without a need of physical interaction between the doctor and patient. This wearable device should help the patients' health conditions to be monitored continuously through the wireless communication environment. The proposed system employs physiological sensors such as temperature and heart rate sensors for helping in remote monitoring the physical conditions of the patients reside at their home place and GPS sensor for tracking the location of the patient. The results show that the implemented product could trigger the notification to the remote doctor through the SMS and personal Email if an emergence case or an abnormal condition is detected in human body.

articleTitle: Optimal Cyclic Shift Transposition based Data Hiding for Audio Steganography
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Audio steganography based on optimal compression–encryption image algorithm is demonstrated in this paper. Initially, Dual tree complex wavelet transform (DTCWT) is applied to input cover audio signal. To improve the data hiding process, secret image is encrypted using Cyclic Shift Transposition algorithm (CSTA). After the encryption, Modified Huffman Encoding (MHE) algorithm is used to compress the secret image. Then the proposed encryption-compression secret image is embedded in the audio signal. For embedding, the suggested method selects the optimal position with the help of improved salp swarm optimization (ISSO). Here the traditional SSO algorithm is modified based on the opposition-based learning (OBL). After selecting the optimal position, the encryption-compression secret image is embedded to the audio sub-band. In the extraction phase, from the stego audio the secret image is retrieved. The performance of the proposed is evaluated by peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) and Signal to noise ratio (SNR). Experimental outcomes demonstrate that the implemented audio steganography method maintains embedding quality with high PSNR of 55.82dB with minimum MSE value. The implementation of the proposed method is done by MATLAB.

Author Keywords: salp swarm optimization and opposition-based learning

articleTitle: Transmit Antenna Optimization, Power and Energy Efficient Algorithm in Massive MIMO Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s Wireless Communication World MMIMO (Massive Multiple Input and Multiple Output) is the sounding word and capable system for high data transmission rates in Wireless Systems and Networks (WSN). Higher Data Transmission Rates are achieved by posing many more antennas at base station, as result the power consumption should be more, and the bandwidth requirement also enhanced. To address this issue, in this article an innovative method of selecting the Transmit Antenna by making active and passive combination a novel method is proposed. This novel method not only optimizes the antenna selection but also provides the mechanism of reducing power utilization and energy consumption. Initially we consider the GSA (Gravitational Search Algorithm) with velocity parameter and proposed an alternative velocity, treated as Enhanced Velocity Gravitational Search Algorithm (EV-GAS). Moreover EV-GASA on conventional models of Greedy Algorithm, Antenna Bee Colony, Particle Swarm Optimization, Fierce fly for antenna optimization, Energy and Power consumption. Obtained outcomes are proved the EV-GAS is the prominent algorithm for high data transmission rates.

publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)

All manuscripts have gone through a rigorous review process and accepted manuscripts are revised by authors considering the suggestions of the reviewers.

articleTitle: Simulation study for Total Harmonic Distortion of a 3-phase Inverter using Gravitational Search Algorithm and PSO Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With rapid advancement in technologies used in solid-state electronics, nowadays, the conversion and control of electrical power has become easy due to inclusion of power electronics-based devices. With the help of these devices, accurate and smooth control of electrical power conversion can be consummated in three-phase voltage source inverters. But uses of power electronics devices also result in Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), which distorts overall system performance. Eliminating some selected harmonic in a system can quickly be done by using optimization techniques. This manuscript focuses on analysis of harmonics in a 3-phase voltage source inverter using Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) technique.

articleTitle: Braille Keyboard Voice Computer
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This technology is capable of producing a project-based method for blind persons to learn Braille. Whatever system is currently in use is still an analogue system, but we are now using a digital method. This system includes input devices such as a keyboard with Braille dot language keys, as well as a keypad that is connected to the CPU (microcontroller). The microcontroller unit reads the data from the keypad and determines which keys are present. When the OK key is hit, a pre-recorded voice message from voice IC is activated. We can teach Braille students at a higher level and improve their learning by employing this technique. The AP33R voice module is appropriate for applications like telephones, Warnings about security and access control, museum narrations, and more each channel has a maximum capacity. Up to one minute of recorded voice and/or music, with a total recording time of eight minutes. Using the built-in microphone and the push-to-record button, recording is simple and quick.

articleTitle: A Real time NAB-IoT based networkdesign using Swarm intelligence technique
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Many electronic industries have become prominent with Internet of Things (IoT) has grown in popularity over years. The NAB-IoT technology is steadily improving in terms of intelligent, accessibility, power efficiency, strong connection, & extensive coverage. This move is mainly due to the introduction of Narrowband Internet of Things (NAB-IoT). NAB-IoT is a brand-new platform through a diverse set of applications, a large number of interconnections, low energy, and cheap cost. The smart scheme that is based on Swarm intelligence NAB-IoT, is a major component of the IoT sector, is extensively implemented and provides a broad variety of possibilities. However, owing to technology, programming, and connection issues, the NAB-IoT-based adaptive system creates reliability concerns. As a consequence, this study looks at the effect of the NAB-IoT system on the dependability of IoT intellectual organizations. The replicated a real-world situation using the NS-3tool, then performed many information transfer experiments and collected important transmission measure indicator data before computing and evaluating the outcomes observed, using quantifiable reliability indications. In that sequence, the 3 main trials change the communication range of the NAB-IoT signaling, raise the amount of NAB-IoT data accessibility in the classification, and raise the number of difficulties in the route of communication. The investigating findings are characterized by the SINR, quantity, rate of packet loss, and rate of correct received data block and loss. Lastly, analyze the empirical values to confirm the NAB-IoT system’s effect on classification dependability. end to delay improved by 17.14%, Routing Overhead 7.14%, Throughput 2.732%, Energy Efficiency 7.1328% and PDF 11.42% had been attained.

articleTitle: A Review on Machine-Learning Techniques for Estimation of Bitcoin Pricing
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: After the incorporation of machine learning algorithms and regression techniques, this research exhibits the comparison between their individual accuracies. It uses regression models with 80 percent training and 20 percent testing allocation correspondingly with a random state of 10. Various models such as linear regression, lasso regression, ridge regression, polynomial regression, k-nearest neighbour and support vector machine (SVM-Linear) are used for comparison of their accuracies. The obtained dataset contains a variety of parameters which are considered for the comparison and thereby reviewed.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: DNA based Data Encryption using AES Agorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the last two decades, VLSI technology has exploded in popularity, particularly in network security, where information processing cryptography has received a lot of attention. Cryptography provides a safe channel between the sender and the receiver for data transmission. Millions of online transactions, such as trading, banking, e-commerce, and social networking, take place every second around the world, exchanging data between users.As the internet has grown in popularity, so has the number of hackers and cyber attacks on networks.Network security has become a major concern in the modern era, and data protection has become so important that unbreakable encryption technology should be developed to provide data security. This paper presents a new approach to the structure of Deoxyribonucleic Acid(DNA) with four nucleotides called A (Adenine), C (Cytosine), G (Guanine) and T (Thymine) are the elements that exist in the DNA system that is added to both the key and cipher that are merged and transferred in the shape of a protein through a channel that improves protection. The Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) architecture and its dynamically changing behavior with partial reconfiguration are ideal for a broad range of applications that can be designed to incorporate custom designs and needs. Implemented on Verilog HDL, synthesized in Xilinx simulator.

articleTitle: Masked Face Recognition using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Face Masks have become part of our day-to-day activities. But these create a problem with the existing face recognition techniques. Existing face recognition techniques vary from simple ML techniques such as SVM, PCA, etc. to state-of-the-art models such as ResNet, VGG, etc. In this paper, we are studying the effects of masked faces on the performance of face recognition techniques. Face recognition itself is divided into face verification and face identification. This study is performed for the face identification task using different deep learning models. In particular, we are studying the pre-trained deep learning models that are trained using transfer learning for face identification tasks. In this study, a custom dataset is used consisting of 65 subjects. The custom dataset is a part of the VGGFace2 dataset. Subject faces are augmented with masks. The dataset doesn’t consist the faces without masks. In this study, we are using different popular pre-trained models such as VGG16, InceptionV3, etc. We are re-training those pre-trained models on a custom dataset and analyzing the gathered results. Apart from the pre-trained models, a new model has been proposed for the masked face identification task.

articleTitle: Data Analysis on Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The spread of COVID-19 across many parts of the world is an issue of concern for all government units of the world. India is also facing this very dark time and trying to control the spread. The source of data has been gathered from multiple sources and many other certified websites. The need is to predict the future accurately by telling when number will reach its peak and when it will decrease. Identities such as sex, longitudes and latitudes, age factor, etc. have been represented using R, data visualization techniques. Covid-19 analysis is the process of investigating number of people suffering from this on the basis of collection of data on growth rate through the use of networks.

articleTitle: Recognition and Extraction of Banking Data using OCR
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The procedure of reserving data from bank records into the bank database is a long and an erroneous chore. In this module we suggest a structure that examines bank records and withdraws data from them in the form of text which can additionally be reserved in the bank dataset easily.In the system suggested, the attributes of every character written in the data inputted are drawn out and then transferred towards the neural network. Texts containing datasets that are put in writing by various persons are brought to use to teach the system. The identification system proposed provides great levels of accuracy in comparison to the already existing approaches in this field. This structure can efficiently identify texts and transform them into structural form which can be effortlessly stored and organized.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Non-Linear State Estimation Filter in Presence of Non Gaussian Underwater Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research paper mainly focusing on assessing the functioning of filter in Non-Gaussian noise (Non-GN) in underwater target tracking environment. Here the measurements coming from the target like bearings and elevation measurements are consider to be corrupted with Gaussian noise(GN) and non-Gaussian noises(Non-GN). Gaussian mixture (GM) and short noise (SN) are consider in Non-GN and assuming that in phase sampled measurements are generated spontaneously with some specific time, and increases the burden of filter. Calculating the efficiency of Modified gain extended kalman filter (MGEKF) and cubature kalman filter (CKF), by elevating plenty of scenarios. Comparing those results with Cramer-Rao Lower bound (CRLB).

articleTitle: A Research on Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) Strategies for English Words
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: These days Hand composed Text Recognition (HTR) is major surprising & troublesome examination space for space of Photo handling. By and by different acknowledgment procedures are in notable used for acknowledgment of manually written English letters in order (character). Application area of HCR is computerized record preparing like mining data from information passage, check, applications for advances, Visas, charge, medical coverage structures and so forth During this overview we present a layout of ebb and flow research work led for acknowledgment of manually written English letter sets. In Handwritten composition there is no limitation on the composing procedure. Manually written letters in order are muddled to perceive due to different human penmanship procedure, distinction fit as a fiddle of letters, point. An assortment of acknowledgment techniques for transcribed English letters in order are consulted here close by its exhibition.

articleTitle: Smart Campus an Android Application using IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this digital age, people' lives are becoming easier as well as simpler. Almost all is automated, replacing the manual processes of old days. The Internet has now become an integral part of the human lifestyle that they are powerless without. The Internet of Things (IoT) offers a forum in this project where devices are often remotely connected, sensed and managed through the infrastructure of the network. Internet of things devices control as well as tracks the computer, power supply, whereas the manual devices to be used on a campus. Therefore, numerous actions are operated by a single admin. It is connected to the cloud server and allows for a range of sensors and power points as well. As it is often expanded by linking and managing a number of different devices, the built framework is cost-effective and scalable. The embedded items throughout the cyber space have online or offline representation, sensing/actuation capacity, a programmability capability, and thus are clearly recognizable. This display includes details, such as the description of the item, position, place or even other business, social or private details.

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis Using Hazard Rate Model Under Cloud Operation with Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays many users are using several software services depending on cloud computing and big data. Taking into account the reliability of cloud world, this is essential for managers of cloud to find the relationship between HTTP server software, cloud and database so that close relationship can be shown among cloud and database using the network of internet. Moreover, it is also essential to study that HTTP server software act as a main pillar of cloud software. So, a software reliability method is suggested here using a 3D data clustering in the cloud world accompanied by big data. A cluster analysis is done with the help of k- means clustering for the software data fault. Furthermore, reliability analysis is shown through many numerical examples in the environment of cloud computing using big data.

articleTitle: Hate Speech Detection Using Multi-Channel Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As we are used to seeing the Internet as a mode of availability that is available at our doorstep, it is no wonder that we have access to a number of online stages. Increasing their use brings both advantages and disadvantages. One of such disadvantages is hate speech. Hate speech is a subject of worry for online media stages. With powerfully expanding datasets manual mediation of posts is very inconceivable or will be tedious. Hate speech detection should be an automated task to distinguish hate speech from the provided input. In this work, we have implemented a deep learning model multi-channel convolutional neural network (MCCNN). The model consists of 3 channels of Convolutional Neural Network. Each channel is merged and connected to a fully connected layer from where the final output is obtained. We have compared our model with a single-channel convolution neural network and results have shown that MCCNN outperformed simple CNN. The accuracy and F1-score achieved by our model are 95.49 and 93.93 for dataset D1 and for dataset D2 97.85% and 95.74% respectively.

articleTitle: A Critical Study on The Impact of Covid-19 Pandemic on The Tourism Industry at Nainital, Uttarakhand, India
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nainital is a well-known hill station in Uttarakhand, India where there is footfall of thousands of tourists every year. Tourism industry at Nainital has always been the main source of income for the people of Nainital. This business has continuously aided in generating high revenue for Uttarakhand State Government. Due to the advent of Covid-19 pandemic, the Government of India enforced complete and partial lockdowns from time to time during 2020-2021 as a measure to control the existing hazardous circumstances prevailing in the country. This brought a drastic blow to the tourism industry at Nainital as well and directly affected the economy of the Uttarakhand State. The abrupt downfall in the industry due to covid -19 instigated the researchers to analyze the scenario in the duration 2020-2021. There were periods of lockdown as well as unlock/partial lockdown in this duration. The researchers analyzed the impact of the pandemic in the tourism industry at Nainital in both the stages-during lockdown and unlock/ partial lockdown. A SWOC (Strengths, Weaknesses, and Opportunities & Challenges) analysis was taken up as an effective warfare mechanism against the ubiquitous unpleasant situation. It was decoded that the surging conditions precipitated from certain psychological and behavioral impediments of all the three components- Government, Public and Covid 19 virus, which were essentially required to be mapped. The present pyramid study is imperial in nature. In the present study the researchers have focused on the study of relationship between the first two components-Government and Public and the third component-Virus of the pyramid. It attempts to trace the impact of these three components on one another through questionnaire survey, group discussion, and telephonic interview. In the present study the researchers not only consider the impact of the pandemic on the unemployment and economy of the state but also on the psychology of the local people as- a-whole. The present study is a visionary and rationalist wherein the researchers consider the scope of survival of tourism industry at Nainital in 2022.

articleTitle: Analysis of EMG Waveform for the Control of 3D Printed Bionic Leg for Amputee
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A huge number of lower limb removals are completed far and wide consistently because of diabetes, circulatory and vascular infection, injury, or malignancy. The removal cycle is one of the techniques when recreation medical procedure can't give a sufficient arrangement or the injury to the appendage which is too extreme. There are prosthetic lower limbs available for the amputees as a commercial solution which is too expensive and only available in developed countries. In our design, the lower limb is constrained by strong waves that had been received from EMG (Electromyography Signals). The lower limb is made up of 3D modeling (3D printed limb). Resulting in the motor driving with the help of an algorithm in Arduino Uno. At that point, the ideal developments of the end effectors are received to give a reasonable arrangement by a "3D PRINTED LOWER LIMB" which is constrained by EMG signals.

articleTitle: Realization of Combinational Circuits Using A Proposed Reversible Gate
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Because of the tremendous importance of very low power consumption, reversible logic synthesis came out as a significant method in circuit design. It is one of several design strategies available for creating digital logic circuits. Here we have presented a reversible gate which, the ‘HAS’ gate, that can function as a Universal circuit. The suggested gate can carry out fundamental operations such as AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, and so on. It also can be used to perform the complex functionalities of adder, subtractor, decoder, multiplexer, magnitude comparator etc. The proposed design efficiently implements all the basic functionalities of all combinational circuits with ease.

articleTitle: Indian Public Interest and Anxiety Surge in COVID-19 Subsequent to a Strong Epidemic in Italy and Spain through a Survey using Google Trends
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A new Coronavirus has caused panic wave among the public all over the world. It is being discussed extensively in various news channels and papers each day. The most affected countries are China, Italy, Spain, and USA. In India, more than 5000 cases have been reported and the number is increasing day by day. This paper has undertaken good use of Google Trends to analyse the public interest in COVID-19 outbreak. Google Trends has been used to collect data pertaining to Indian public interest in Corona Virus.Methods: Current data pertaining to public interest in Corona virus is extracted from Google Trends website by entering the search topic: COVID-19 with location set as India. The reported period is 10th March 2020 to 8th April 2020. The second data regarding mental health query of Indians is also extracted from the same tool.Results: As per the Google Trends observed for Indian public interest in COVID-19, the interest started rising from 10th March,2020 and was gradually moving up till 21stMarch 2020 while number of reported corona cases in India had started emerging and lockdown was enforced on the public movement. The interest in COVID-19 doubled in just a time of one week from 21st march, 2020.Similar trend has been found with Indian mental hearth search queries showing first peak on 13th March, second on 19th and third on 24th March 2020. The last peak which is highest one involves almost triple population than the first peak. Hence Google trends can be used to predict the mental health and sensitivity of the people towards disease.

articleTitle: Adaptive Algorithms Comparison and Analysis for Beamforming Application in Smart Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the field of wireless communications effective and authentic usage of spectrum will be an added advantage to achieve the desired capacity for a communication system. So minimizing the interference within the channel would give a greater dominance over the increase of channel capacity and the signal bandwidth. This means that improving the gain in the direction of arrival (DOA) and inserting null values at interference points is critical to increasing the capacities of a radio channels, which is why smart antennas are so important. To get the optimal weight vector of antenna array components for beamforming, adaptive algorithms play a vital role. When antenna elements in a uniform linear array were rearranged, we assessed the performance of three methods: the MATLAB-based Least Mean Square (LMS), the LMF-based LMF, and the LMMN-based LMMN techniques.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection: Needs for Individuals and Businesses in the time of Covid-19 and its Future Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Today social media plays a very important role in everyone life through which we create online communities to share every kind of information. No one can be one sure about the news they are receiving is true or not? In India, WhatsApp has limited that a person cannot forward a text to more than 5 people at once [1]. This was done to curb the rise of false information. In this paper a machine learning models is create to segregate false and real news. A performance comparison for all the model has been performed in the terms of accuracy. The present article also explores the application of the fake news detector in the real world application.

articleTitle: Development of Smart Agricultural System (IoT) for Crop Productivity
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Web-of-Things (WoT) is a process that involves different sensors or actuators or both that provides connection to the world of internet either heads on or via a different process. Farming quality get improved with the use of modernized systems such as Internet of things (IoT). Agriculture also plays the main role in economics and survival of individuals in India. Damages to crops are done by either extra irrigation or deficit of irrigation. Presently, in Indian agriculture 83% of the entire water is consumed on fields. Wastage of water is caused when there is no planning regarding its proper usage. In this paper, ThingSpeak and NodeMCU, an IoT platform is integrated with Arduino Technology, Breadboard combined with various sensors is demonstrated, which will help the farmers to monitor their crops by using a computer or phone from anywhere and at any time, parameters such as moisture, humidity, temperature etc. in order to reduce his efforts while simultaneously maximising the use of water Sensor data is uploaded to an IoT platform, and if a value falls below a certain threshold, an urgent alert is issued to the user via email, allowing them to take immediate action.

articleTitle: Review of Various Image Processing Techniques for Recognition and Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: India is an agricultural country and the agricultural income is one of the major income source. The rank of India in worldwide agricultural output is second. So the livelihood of the people depends on agriculture. As a result of such factors like disease, pest infestation, and sudden climate change, crop yields are declining. Therefore, automatic detection and classification of plants and its diseases are important. Automatically detection of disease symptoms as they appear on the growing stage provides a huge benefits to farmers. There are so many classification techniques like, support vector machine (SVM), k-Nearest neighbour classifier, Probabilistic Neural network, Convolutional neural network, etc. This paper provides a brief overview of different classification techniques.

articleTitle: Educational Analytics using Modern Methods of Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s Era success rate of students play a major role in overall growth of students, so Higher Educational University use many performance evaluation techniques. Universities use many Statistical, physical examination and data mining technique for evaluating students’ performance Educational datasets are very useful in modern day’s world for extracting important information from it. These information’s can be used to know the important facts about performances. In this paper machine learning and classification techniques are used on educational datasets to predict the important factors for high academic performances. Also, to find out the relation between these individual factors. Prediction is made more accurate by using different data classifications techniques used in data mining and the best suitable classification technique for educational datasets is determined. For this we used modern classifications techniques and kalboard 360 dataset.

articleTitle: A Web Application for Customer Segment based Black Friday Sales Forecast
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The study shows how factors internal to the sales forecasting process can introduce bias. Black Friday is upon us, and retailers everywhere stock up on inventory at dramatic discounts. The products aren't accessible to some clients due to poor arrangements, despite good sales. Managing a small staff and keeping potential customers in mind is more of a concern for shopkeepers. Despite some attempts at effective inventory management and sales forecast, the results have not been favorable. A prediction model has proven effective in managing this issue. By analyzing the previous spending patterns of clients, a precise and efficient algorithm can predict future spending. A variety of data analysis strategies, including regressors and classifiers, are employed to evaluate specificity and accuracy. Then, different algorithms are used to implement machine learning techniques. An extensive report of sales for Black Friday 2019 has been compiled. To calculate the volume, we took into account various factors, including age group, occupation, product category, city, etc. A store that wishes to predict sales could do so from this information. We have deployed our Flask-based user interface after determining which model is the best fit.

articleTitle: Outdoor Mask - Wearing Surveillance System Using Facial Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A mask on the face has become a new normal lifestyle due to the Covid-19 pandemic. Even after a year, spread of corona virus is increasing and people cannot go out without wearing a mask. All service providers in day- to-day life don’t allow their customers avail their services without mask. Face mask detection has really been one of the most common and trendy as well as an important topic in today’s time to help people take precautions and don’t forget to wear their masks. In this article, we have presented a face mask detector using some basic machine learning packages in-built in python like TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, MobileNet.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Salary Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Employee recruitment is a main activity of any business for smooth conduction of the companies’ production and competitiveness. Salary is also a motivational key parameter for any employee to fulfill his expectations, according to his qualification and technical skill. Our salary prediction system is aimed at providing better assistance to the college students regarding the salary that they can aspect after completing their course. Not only they will be able to get an idea of their deserving salary but also, they can get to know about the skills that they need to meet their professional goals. This will enhance the motivation of students who are enrolled in higher education institutes and provide better assistance also. Through this paper, we have tried to provide a system for salary prediction in which data mining technique is used. In this system the profile of student will be compared with graduated student. We have used data mining techniques for comparison as they perform best. We have also performed an experiment on student data set using 10-fold cross-validation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Online Media Content Using Data Science Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: online media content plays an important role on the social media. It consists of textual, visual, audio, video, images and animations. The idea of the web is to link different content that is available on different web sites. This may include personal web pages, YouTube channels, files, email messages and more. The content present on the social media is not all genuine and every content is not quality content. Some websites use fake thumbnails to attract content to their site but the content is of low quality. Google penalized many websites who are doing this type of work.
