There should be a content management system to manage the content on all these types of websites. The websites should make their content user friendly so that the site can be navigated easily. This paper provides review of various data science techniques used on social media dataset for online media content. In this survey, we also describe some online content problems that can be solved by using data mining techniques.

articleTitle: Improved FGMRP Routing Protocol to Solve Energy Hole Problem in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In wireless sensor network sensor nodes can sense the information which is based upon the decentralized technique and self-configuring type of network and pass it to the base station. Energy consumption is the major problem related to the wireless sensor and far deployment which is due to decentralized network. In this research paper we work on FGMRP protocol which is performed and upgraded to increase the existence in wireless sensor networks. The basic working of FGMRP protocol is that total network is prorated into assemblage and assemblage heads are deployed in each cluster of the wireless sensor network. In the network the leader nodes are also chosen which collect the information from cluster heads and pass to the base station. In the enhancement of FGMRP protocol to increase the existence of wireless sensor network, more gateway nodes are stationed. In the proposed system the leader nodes send the date to gateway nodes which are deployed near to the base station. The cluster head gives the information to the leader nodes. The proposed FGMRP protocol and FGMRP protocol are performed through the simulator NS2.

articleTitle: Predicting Employee Selection using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Employee selection is the most vital function of HRM as it has a significant impact on company’s revenue growth and profit margins. Developing a strong and rigorous selection process ensures that the organization is able to achieve the objectives and at the same time saves money, time and energy on replacing and training new people. The aim of this paper is to construct a decision support model for employee selection using the concept of data mining classification. There are six data mining classification algorithms compared in this case, namely Linear regression, KNN, Random Forest, neural network, AdaBoost and stochastic gradient descent. The algorithm with the highest accuracy is utilized to produce the rule for DSM. The results are Random Forest has the highest accuracy of 92%; hence this algorithm is selected to process the value of twelve predictor parameter to identify the most appropriate employee during the selection process.

articleTitle: Battery Lifetime Enhancement in Wireless Sensor Networks using Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a state of art technology for improving the lifetime of battery in conjunction with artificial intelligence techniques. A WSN is an intensive group of different miniature devices called sensor nodes, which help to monitor external or internal environmental conditions like luminosity and weather parameters such as pressure, sound, temperature, and humidity. These nodes are embedded with various devices like sensing components, computer-based input and output devices, radio transceivers and other power related components. These are inherently interconnected resource based constraints like limited storage capacity, communication bandwidth and limited processing speed. There is a need to adapt self-organizing nodes mechanism to match the application in order to minimize the intermediate nodes power consuming and longevity of the battery used in sensor network. These monitor dynamic paths change more often in over times, so sensor networks often adopt artificial intelligence techniques like neural networks to solve the need, such as to reduce the intermediate nodes power consuming and maximization of resource utilization sources and enhance the life period of the sensor network. This manuscript presents an absence of middle nodes inactive time, power consumption is minimized, therefore, the life time of battery to be maximized and better utilization of resources are possible.

articleTitle: RUN Algorithm Based 2D-PIDF-(1+PIDDFF) Controller for Load Frequency Control in a Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This study presents the optimal design of a 2D-PIDF-(1+PIDDFF) controller using the RUN algorithm for control of the frequency of a multi-micro grid. For tuning the parameters of the controller, Integral of Time multiplied Absolute Error (ITAE) is considered here as the objective function. Considering various distributed energy resources (DERs), renewable energy sources (RES), and energy storage systems, a multi-microgrid model is designed. A recently published RUN algorithm utilizing the Runge Kutta method is applied for tuning parameters of controllers. Two-degree of freedom PID with derivative filter cascaded with PI with double derivative & derivative filters named as 2D-PIDF-(1+PIDDFF) is proposed here as frequency controller. The efficacy of the proposed RUN tuned 2D-PIDF-(1+PIDDFF) controller for frequency regulation is compared over other RUN tuned PIDF, 1+PIDDFF, PIDF-(1+PIDDFF), and CMVO tuned PID and FPIDF-OM. Out of these controllers, minimum ITAE is obtained by RUN tuned 2D-PIDF-(1+PIDDFF) controller with an improved dynamic response, which shows its usefulness.

articleTitle: Teacher Assistance Android Application
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Understudy's participation following is an essential issue so as to screen understudies exhibition in the study hall just as in their examinations. It turns into a key concern in light of the fact that the authority of educational institution keeps up a standard that one understudy can possibly go to the test if his/her participation is equivalent or higher to a few rates (60%,70% or 80% and so on.) in any case not. This is pointlessly tedious to notice and imprint understudy's name on the participation sheet. This additionally happens a few understudies may incidentally or readily mark the understudy's name like as intermediary. The printed version of participation sheet may get lost. Utilizing Advanced cell like as Android Innovation the course instructor will have the option to gauge participation effectively by our planned versatile application and spare the participation in the phone. To evade these issues, this paper presents a portable application for understudy participation and imprint the board framework. This application is chiefly intended for the resources and other staff individuals from the association who keep up participation and stamps consistently. Utilizing this framework, the subject handlers, staffs or the specialists can check the quantity of understudies present or missing in the class meetings. The proposed application permits the clients to stamp participation through cell phones and to stay in contact with understudies.

articleTitle: CNN Based Speech and Text Translation Using Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: There are around 5,00,000 deaf and hard of hearing persons in the globe. Around 60% of peoples are born as a deaf and deafeningly. These kinds of peoples are not able to understand anything like as normal peoples. The sign language (i.e., hand movements) are used for the dumb and deaf to pass their messages. These people’s faces lots of challenges on daily basis due to the relative absence of widespread sign language use in society. The helplessness to talk seems like true impairment. People with this defacement communicate in entirely several means. There are a variety of choices present for communication where sign language is one of the ways. Applications existence for sign language is necessary for dumb people so that they become able to talk easily with them who does not know sign language motions. The objective here is to take the essential acts in sustaining the language gap between conventional people and verbally challenged people. Communication becomes extremely difficult for them, the chance that they can talk is through language of sign. Though a dumb or deaf person might know language of sign, the people with whom she wishes to speak might not. Our aim to overcome this difference by using machine learning and neural networks to analyze sign language and translate it to text and voice.

articleTitle: Optimal Location and Proper Size Solar Based MLDG System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper, a solar-based hybrid system has been designed for Maximum penetration with minimum loss an analytical approach has been used for optimal size and location of solar-based MLDG (Multiple locations distributed generator) in LV network. The main aim of this paper is the reduction of penetration loss with maximum penetration and improved voltage profile with economic benefits. A 3-bus solar-based MLDG system has been designed and DG is placed at a location with proper size such that penetration loss is minimum with improved voltage profile. The proposed approach is tested at a 3-bus MLDG system and found that deigned system is feasible with an improved voltage profile. The voltage profile of deigned MLDG system is improved by nearly 57.5%. The placement of multiple DG with proper size is more effective and economical compared to single DG placement. 2/3 rule of DG placement in LV network is implemented and load flow analysis has been used to calculate bus power.

articleTitle: Lane and Curve Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: We hear almost every day about the development of self-driving cars. One of the major problems in the development of self-driving cars is lane detection and also the detection of the curve in the lane. In this paper, we have discussed various algorithms and combine them to find the lane and curvature of the lane. Our aim to develop a running program that can detect the lane and curve in a running video. We have used the various Computer Vision algorithms and OpenCV libraries for lane and curve detection. With the help of these algorithms and libraries, we were able to find the lane and the curvature of the lane in a running video. But if the lane marking is not present or there is distorted lane marking then the program does not provide the desired output.

Author Keywords: HLS channel of HSV color space

articleTitle: Internet of Things in Motion Detection and Environment Monitoring in Agricultural field
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The manual in-person survey of open farm agricultural field is a tedious job. For making this job easy and much effective I have built an IOT based surveillance system which will monitor any harmful changes occurring on the environment of the field and provide the user with the real-time information. This information will contain the different environmental changes that may cause harm to the crop or even cause some insufficient growth. Monitoring of movements of unwanted animals is also done in/around the field to get a warning if there is chance of harm to the crop from these animals. For the prevention methods sprinklers are used in case of a fire and also buzzer is used for scaring away unwanted animals.

articleTitle: A Contemporary Study on Expansive Soil Subgrades By Using CBR Technique With Geotextiles
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Filling materials and the sub grade process have a significant impact on the roadway surface’s performance. The building of a road on soil with a soft sub grade might have a substantial influence on the project’s schedule and cost. Sub grade robustness may also be described as CBR (California bearing ratio), which is the ratio of load test to standard load at specified penetration by the use of an appropriate plunger for that particular sub grade. The adaptable pavement design in India is mostly dependent on the CBR sub grade here in India. There are a number of ways to improve the subsoil of a highway’s soils. The stabilization methods are the most prevalent between them. In recent decades, geosynthetics have been used to stabilize soil soft sub grades. The purpose of this research is to detect an increase in CBR values mobilization resilience by performing sub grade soil CBR tests when geotextile reinforcement has been applied in a variety of sites. In addition, geotextiles and expansive-silty-clay-soil were used in this investigation. Furthermore, CBR tests have been carried out by retaining geotextile at several levels from the top of the CBR moulds to the bottom of the soils.

articleTitle: Electro-Mechanical Performance Analysis of Force and Stress in Automotive Connecting Rod
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The main objective of this study was to perform static as well as fatigue analysis of the Maruti Suzuki Eeco engine connecting rod. This study was divided into two steps, first, analysis of various forces acting on the connecting rod and, second, static and fatigue analysis followed by design optimization of connecting rod.In the first part of this analysis, inertia force and gas pressure force experienced by the connecting rod was evaluated at given engine speed. Inertia force which is the combination of primary force and secondary force was modeled in MS Excel sheet at different crank angles. Gas pressure force based on thermodynamics model was also included in this sheet. Further these loads were applied on connecting rod with Finite Element Methods. 3-D model of component was prepared in SolidWorks and then imported to ANSYS. Finite Element Analysis was carried out for two different materials of connecting rod under same boundary conditions. The results of this analysis indicated that maximum stress was found to occur at fillet sections of connecting rod for both materials. So, design modification was required at these sections.

articleTitle: A New Setup Vigorous DOA Method of Several Sources for gNB NG-Core Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper emplacement of Desired user signal is examined. Surrounded by the number of users, emplacement process is very major role in wireless communications application like 5G and radar applications. The efficacy of fix on target of user in next generation wireless communication foremost to find desired and undesired user positions. In present days communication technologies improving very fast according to that fast growth of communication Technologies and to overcome drawbacks from1G to 4G, improves the signal quality and direction of desired user to be estimates because of that in this paper introduced the multiple signal classification algorithm (MUSIC) and LMS algorithm for Estimate the Desired user direction and find the beam pattern of wanted user and unwanted users’ direction. This paper presents calculation of user positions and beampatterns by applying the wireless communication Techniques to get the better results by varying the control parameters and antenna parameters and minimize the received signal noise in next generation wireless application which construct many of alternative links for other users got NG-core networks which is supported by 5G application.

articleTitle: Underwater State Estimation using Bearings only Measurements with an Emphasis on Sonar
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Surveillance in underwater is very important in naval defence system. This is done by using the acoustic/sound waves in underwater rather than optic/ electromagnetic waves as these are susceptible to high attenuation. The Sonar which uses the acoustic waves to detect and track the target is mounted/ placed on the observer ship/ submarine. The Sonar generate the bearing measurements. Sonar operates both in active and passive modes. Sonar operating in passive mode is generally preferred as there is less or no risk for the observer of being tracked by the target. In this research work, an overview of sonar operation is presented and the unscented Kalman filter algorithm is applied to track the target path using bearing measurements. The simulation results are presented obtained using Matlab. The UKF algorithm is evaluated using Monte-Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Realtime Aid for Blind Using Python
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: I-EYE (Intelligent Eye) is an innovation to help the blind people in their day-to-day life with the use of disciplines like computer science, electronics and embedded engineering and health science. This work helps the blind person to walk freely, comfortably and with confidence. The device uses the technology of artificial vision (image processing) and deep learning by incorporating all into a wearable cap which enhance their difficulty to walk alone. In this paper we have present a review on Deep learning neural network-based object detection framework namely CNN (convolution neural network). Our device recognizes the obstacles or any object in front of it and give output through speaker or headphone. The idea is to detect any object in front of the device like if there is a pole in the way our device automatically recognizes it and gives an alarm to the person through earphone that "There is a pole" which help the blind person to easily get out of any upcoming problems. We are using Python programming to code our deep learning neural network task and using Raspberry Pi processing unit to implement the work. Our device also consists of proximity sensors for easy and fast detection of the object nearby. The main goal of our work is to help the unfortunate visually impaired person with fast and affordable technology. This is an automated device as it is using machine learning and deep learning technology. Surely this project is going to help millions of blind people in their regular living life

articleTitle: Experimental Performance Analysis of The Effect of Nano Particles on Computer Controlled Infusion Type MQL Grinding Process
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the expansion of innovation practices, design and development of improved quality products requires advanced surface finishing procedures. Thus for achieving this high quality surface finish, aftermath of processes such as grinding etc. are performed, which eventually result in rising the temperature at work piece-tool interactions, deteriorating the quality of product produced. In the present work, study has been made to explore the surface roughness of Computer Controlled infusion type Minimum Quantity Lubrication (MQL) grinding of AISI-52100 alloy steel. Superior results have been taken from the MQL grinding with nanoparticles of Al2O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> alongside using vegetables oil under different parameters.

Author Keywords: Computer Controlled infusion type Minimum Quantity Lubrication (MQL)

articleTitle: Trust based Mechanism for Detection and Isolation of DDOS Attack in Software Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: SDN networks are different from the classic networks in terms of features. Different from SDN, in classic networks, networking tool stake decision regarding the handling of an arriving packet just on the address of its IP destination. The attacking nodes after making entry in the network may activate a DDoS attack. This research work is an attempt of detecting these compromised nodes by implementing a trust-based approach. The trust-assisted approach involves computing the trust level of the allnetwork nodes. The node with minimal trust is labelled as the malevolent node. The trust is calculated on the basis of the number of packets as transmitted node during the time period. The node which has transmitted maximum packets and consumes least resources will be marked as malicious node from the network. The proposed model is implemented in NS2 and the results are analysed in terms of certain parameters such as throughput, delay and overhead. To compute trust, the number of packets forwarded by the nodes in a certain period are considered.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Stereo-Matching Technologies for Emphasizing Stereo-Vision Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Stereo vision is a growing research domain which seeks the attention of various researchers to attain deeper scene extraction. This work provides an extensive analysis towards the stereo-matching algorithms and stereo-vision to resolve the problems related to it. The analysis towards the stereo matching technologies is executed with benchmark standards with the focus on stereo vision methods. Thus the comparison of stereo matching algorithms can be done through the implementation of stereo vision application in a particular domain so that the results for the algorithms are comparatively analyzed. In most cases, the analysis and comparison are performed with statistical analysis and emphasize the benefits of various stereo algorithms. Some approaches give higher computational cost with expected outcomes over the lower time frame and provides competency towards parallel processing. The results obtained from the various stereo matching algorithms through the identified different parameters of bad pixels.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Framework for Visual to Caption Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In reality videography possesses complicated dynamics; and open-domain interpretation methods should be time-sensitive and enable both variable-size input (frame sequence) and output (word sequence). To address the issue, here we suggest a pioneering head-to-head or sequence-to-sequence model for creating video captions or descriptions. We use recurrent neural networks, particularly Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, to do this, since they have shown avant-garde success in the production of picture captions. The training of the LSTM model is based on video-phrase pairs and it acquires its knowledge by equating a series of visual frames with a succession of words to produce a summary of the snippet's occurrence. The proposed model V2CT has shown signs to grasp both the temporal structure of a series of frames and the series model of the formed phrases, i.e., a dialect model. The model is trained and tested on a common collection of YouTube videos (MSVD dataset).

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Single Point Turning Tool using Condition Monitoring and NI-DAQ
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Monitoring the status of cutting tools in any machining operation is a key element to avoid unexpected machining trouble. Breakdowns and instabilities in machining processes and tool peripheries may be detrimental to efficacy, therefore, it becomes crucial to investigate the real-time condition of the tool to improve the efficiency of the overall process. The present work demonstrates the use of vibration signature analysis, adopting National Instruments Data Acquisition System (NI-DAQ). The vibration signals shall be monitored and used to establish a real time relationship between monitoring and the performance evaluation of single point tool. The acquired vibration signals were visualized and analyzed to correlate the power spectrum values with tool wear of the tool for EN-31 workpiece. Further, it was observed that with an increment in depth of cut from 0.25 mm to 2 mm, the power spectrum values first decreases then increase until the tool wear reaches to 300 μm.

articleTitle: Design of an Efficient 4-Bit Serial Parallel Multiplier using QCA
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This report provides an effective multi-layer serial-parallel 4-bit multiplier (SPM) using QCA technology. Using a completely used majority gate (MV) and a revised compact and flexible exclusive-OR (C-XOR) gate, we built a bit-serial full adder (BSA). The suggested C-XOR gate has been realized using the QCA cell's properties. For 4-bit multiplier, this updated circuit corresponds to a 38 percent and 26 percent reduction in number of QCA cells and occupied area analogized to the previous design. With QCADesigner, all the proposed layouts were simulated and tested.

articleTitle: Voice Feature Analysis For Speaker Recognition To Improve Content Management
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: We are introducing feature extraction approach which helps in content control on broadband television. Speaker recognition-based content control are more effective as compare to traditional permission-based method. Television content can be controlled based on the program requester’s age and program requester’s age can be identified based on his/her voice. Speaker is adult or not that can be identified based on his/her voice. Every person’s voice is unique based on voice features like pitch, frequency, jitter, amplitude, and spectral power. This article explains how we can effectively use these features to classify child and adult voice. In general, Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC) is used for effective feature extraction and it provides features’ numerical values. Artificial Intelligence (AI) based system uses these features for accurate speaker recognition. Child and adult voice can be differentiate at time, frequency, mel scale level, which can help for clear classification of the speaker. Power spectrum and mel-spectrum also represent difference in child and adult voice.

articleTitle: An Open air outdoor Environment for Children in Urban Residential Precinct
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The child-friendly approaches in Urban planning and designing have been initiated globally to fill the gap that has been created by the overlooking child as a stakeholder. To support child-friendly methods, it is necessary to look at suitable standards and guidelines on safety, built and spatial environment quality; it should also promote equal opportunities for differently-abled and encourage children’s participation in decision-making. This research paper will aim for developing guidelines by understanding the spatial needs of the children through their development process. To demonstrate the demand, issues and the design guidelines, a residential precinct in Visakhapatnam City has been taken as a case study. The frameworks of child development and quality indicators of child-friendly spaces are used for analyzing the neighbourhood. Random sample and stratifies sampling methods are used along with visual observations as a data collection method. From the results and findings of the data collected, an attempt is made to list the guidelines for child-friendly residential precincts formulated as an outcome of this research paper.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of The Machining Parameters of The Computer Controlled Wire EDM to Improve The Surface Roughness of Nimonic 80 Alloy
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this current experimental study of machining the Nimonic 80-A alloy on computer-controlled wire EDM, the optimum set of input machining parameters are evaluated. This optimization has been done to improve the surface roughness of the Nimonic 80-A alloy. The four main input parameters like peak current (20-80A), gap voltage (30-60V), pulse-on time (20-70µs) and pulse-off time (25-75µs) are considered within this range. The different optimal levels of the parameters to be set on WEDM for doing the experiments were proposed by the Taguchi L27 orthogonal array. Talysurf tester has been utilized to compute the values of the surface finish. In the aftermath, the signal to noise (S/N) ratio has been adopted for optimizing the machining parameters with respect to surface roughness. This provided the interaction plots of the input factors with surface roughness. The optimum results of machining parameters obtained are peak current 20A, gap voltage 30V, pulse-on time 20µs and pulse-off time 75µs. Further the results of Taguchi analysis made it evident that the peak current is the influencing factor in improving the effectiveness and quality of surface finish.

articleTitle: COVID – Development of Mathematical Model for Transmission of Corona Virus and Analysis of Its Data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 and 2020 (COVID-19), a newly emerged respiratory disease .Worldwide attention has been generated because of this unprecedented situation. An effective strategy need to be developed for controlling the COVID-19 pandemic must be developed which must be highly accurate methods SARS-CoV-2 infected cases[1]. It was provisionally named as 2019-nCoV, But now it has been renamed as SARS-CoV-2 according to the Coronavirus Study Group of the International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses[2]. SARS-CoV-2 belongs to the Coronaviridae family. The novel coronavirus pneumonia is a highly regarded infectious disease worldwide [3]. During pandemic an appropriate clinical decision report must be produced to case in a very short period of time. Rational management of the immune responses to SARSCoV-2, which includes enhancing anti-viral immunity while inhibiting systemic inflammation, may be key to successful treatment.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation System by Feed Forward Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Movie recommendation is powerful in providing improved entertainment. It can suggest a set of movies to users on basis of their interests. In this paper we propose a movie compilation program that has the power to recommend movies to the user on the basis of his interests, preferences and past behaviour. This paper makes use of deep learning techniques for data analysis. Many companies are recognizing the incredible power of neural networks that can come from exposing this wealth of information and are becoming increasingly accustomed to AI systems for automated support. In this paper, the proposed approach is based on neural networks and experimental results are produced based on the dataset MovieLens.

articleTitle: Design of FIR Filter using New Window Function to remove Noisy Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Several miscommunications take place due to the addition of noise when any signal is transmitted to the receiver. To address this problem, a new window function has been contemplated that can be used for the design of FIR filter. Presented paper describes the replacement of window technique during which we proposed a new window function. Because of its spectrum features, the proposed window function, which is constructed from a concatenation of trigonometric functions, is adjustable in nature and shape are often altered consistent with the need by changing controlling parameter regulator. The simulation result shows the output of proposed FIR low pass filter when a signal has been filtered with the presented window function. The spectrum features of the proposed window function, such as Main–lobe width, Side-lobe roll off ratio and Ripple ratio are examined. Their spectral characteristic has been compared with the previously existing window function like Kaiser, Hamming, Tukey, Gaussian. The output of their simulation assured that the proposed window function have better spectral characteristics and signal to noise ratio while compared to the opposite existing window function.

articleTitle: Pipeline Hazards and its Resolutions
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Pipelining is considered a significant execution method utilized in PC equipment for the multi-processing of instructions. However now and again multi-handling might result in a scathing state that might tamper with standard CPU operations in an anticipated manner, or at some point it might cause preparing deferral and produce wrong computational outcomes than anticipated. This situation is known as a hazard. Hazards can be expected to deal with appropriately at the starting, else it may result in pipelining processing being severely harmed or generally execution or calculation might get affected. In this research paper, we have tried to put forward some ideas as to how we can deal with hazards like stalling, forwarding, branch schemes and two others and also introduced ideas of how these hazards impact the normal flow of instruction and also why it is a necessity to remove them.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of COVID-19 from X-ray Images using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Coronavirus, also known as COVID19, is a dangerous disease that has put many people’s lives in jeopardy around the world by damaging the lungs directly. The detection of coronavirus is a challenging medical procedure due to its increasing cases. Currently, the use of x-ray images for coronavirus diagnosis is commonly used. Recently, various deep learning based models have been used for image classification. These models have generated competitive results in terms of feature selection and classification. In this article, we proposed a set of seven pretrained neural network models (VGG16, VGG19, InceptionV3, ResNet50, Xception, DenseNet121 and InceptionResNetV2) for the detection of coronavirus infection using chest X-ray images collected from an open source. It was observed that out of these models, pretrained DenseNet121 yielded highest classification accuracy of 97% for the particular dataset.

articleTitle: High Secure Wireless Video Surveillance Robot using IOT Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a emerging need for remote surveillance and monitoring of our houses in the view of safety and security purpose. A surveillance robot has been proposed which is integrated into any type of household devices. The powerful Arduino based system has been created to capture if any trespassing or obtrusion is detected using a webcam attached to the Arduino controller. It watches the premises and delivers a notification to the authorized person about the video processing. Camera will be always in active mode in order to capture the intruder movement. Those movement also confirmed with various sensors like PIR, ultrasonic sensor and IR sensor. PIR sensor will detect the Live human being or any living organism movie around the premises. And Ultrasonic sensor is used to identify the distance between them to the base station. This system made every user to feel safer using such a kind of device while the Authorised person is away from home or when they have left their children and elderly relatives alone at home. This device plays vital role in surveillance.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Bike Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research paper is based on Bike Rental Prediction. We are confronting various difficulties in the field of our nature earth because of contamination,pollution and different things . Bicycles are the future and will help cleanse the unsafe impacts of vehicles and different things. Bike sharing structures are a strategies for renting bicycles where the path toward obtaining revenue, rental, and bicycle return is modernized by techniques for a relationship of stand locales all through a city. Using these systems, people can rent a bike and return it's anything but an exceptional spot known as a stall . The data created by these systems makes them engaging for experts in light of the fact that the range of development, flight region, appearance region, and time sneaked past is explicitly recorded.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Using Keras in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The paper aims at the extraction of expression features in facial expression recognition. Facial expression identification has become increasingly significant in identifying the emotions of those who are confronted with it, as well as in picture processing. In this paper dataset is used namely the FER2013 dataset, it is a popularly used dataset for exploration and practices. The FER2013 dataset is used to detect facial expressions efficiently. AFERS is applied in this case. Facial detection, face feature extraction, and facial expression recognition are the three stages of this method for detecting facial expressions. And some other methods are also used as Pre-processing and Emotion classification. This paper outlines the efficiency of various widely spread machine learning algorithms for recognizing facial expressions, namely Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes.

articleTitle: Visibility Restoration of Hyperspectral Images
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the applications including aerial and space imagery the use of hyperpsectral images came into existence that includes detection of targets, agricultural, tracking as well as the natural resource exploration. Unfortunately, with the secondary illumination, atmospheric scattering, sensor noise, changing viewing angles the quality of the images is degraded. Enhancing the images has a high pay off since the count of spectral bands is in hundreds that increases a load of computation excessively. Moreover considering the bands separately fails to make use of information present across them. The visibility restoration of the hyperspectral images is a highly desired technology in the applications of computer vision. The situation is also a perplexing task since the visibility of the numerous bands varies and hence are different in the visibility offered by them. To enhance the visibility the consensual purifying is used. The grayscale and color images are produced using the consensual purifying wherein the abstracted image is generated. Then the Gabor purifying is used followed by the use of Gaussian function. The technique proposed is well appropriate for solicitations where each local, as well as comprehensive correlation, exist among the supplementary image beside the enhanced image. Experimental results with HSI data derived from Salinas are demonstrated that are obtainable demonstrating the effectiveness of the projected estimator.

articleTitle: A Review Towards Machine Learning Spectrum for Bioinformatics
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Machine Learning is a science developed as a subfield of Artificial Intelligence in late 90’s. It is a science that will improve in the future. The development in Machine Learning is just because of the difficulty of analyzing and processing the increasing data. The basic principle used in machine learning is just to find the best model for the recent data as compare to the previous one. This research includes information about machine learning, its approaches and how machine Learning is being used in Bioinformatics.

articleTitle: Pitfalls of Conventional MPPT Techniques of Solar PV
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper, the performances of four conventional techniques of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) are evaluated and compared to highlight their shortfalls. The conventional techniques, such as Constant Voltage (CV), Constant Current (CC), Perturb and Observe (P&O) and Incremental Conductance (INC) are considered and their performance are evaluated with the input-output power curves. It is revealed that the P&O technique outperforms the other three.

articleTitle: Model Selection Procedure in Alleviating Drawbacks of The Electronic Whiteboard
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Deep learning has paved the way for critical and revolutionary applications in almost every field of life in general. Ranging from engineering to healthcare, machine learning and deep learning has left its mark as the state-of-the-art technology application which holds the epitome of a reasonable high benchmarked solution. Incorporating neural network architectures into applications has become a common part of any software development process. In this paper, we perform a comparative analysis on the different transfer learning approaches in the domain of hand-written digit recognition. We use two performance measures, loss and accuracy. We later visualize the different results for the training and validation datasets and reach to a unison conclusion. This paper aims to target the drawbacks of the electronic whiteboard with simultaneous focus on the suitable model selection procedure for the digit recognition problem.

articleTitle: Redefining Connectivity With 5G Networks: A Special Focus on Highland Areas
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the advent of 5G networks, the world of cellular communication has had a massive transformation. The introduction of such technologically advanced networks leads ultimately to an incessant increase in the number of users and generates an unimaginable amount of data traffic. Technologies like ultra-dense networks, D2D communication, massive MIMO, fixed wireless access promise a great future ahead for upcoming wireless networks. This also opens doors to research and testing for proposing feasible solutions to explore the untapped potential of 5G in the most remote and a high terrain area as well with the use of path loss models.

articleTitle: Simulation And Modeling of Stand-Alone PV System with 3- Phase Load
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: To meet the Paris agreement goal (to preventing earth temperature from rising more than 2 degrees Celsius) Use of 100 % renewable energy is the best option. The proposed model is tested with different temperatures and irradiation, resultant of P-V and I-V characteristics proved the validation of the proposed MATLAB/SIMULINK model. Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states of India (Mizoram, West Bengal, Tripura, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh Rajasthan, and Gujarat) that’s why India receives maximum energy from the sun. For India, it is appropriate time to shift our 100 % electrical load to solar energy. In this paper modeling of a complete PV system with MPPT (maximum power point tracking) has been presented. The control strategies have been associated with maximum power point tracking technology to maximize PV-generated power to load. PV power with MPPT has been compared with PV power without MPPT. MATLAB tool has been using to design and analyze the PV system.

articleTitle: Intensifying Practical Based Learning of Penetration Testing using CTF
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In a world where we cannot imagine even a single day without a computer, we also need to understand that everyday many unauthorized criminals find exploits in those computers and networks and not only cause disruption in services but also cost huge amount of monetary losses and sometimes demand for ransom. To prevent such security risks, we need people who understand these vulnerabilities and flaws in any system, people who can think like attackers. To find these experts many organizations conduct different types of tests, contests, and interviews. These platforms who conduct such contests are called CTF’s (Capture the Flag) where candidates must find the vulnerabilities and flags in a buggy/vulnerable system. There are flags and checkpoints by problem setter which needs to be submitted by the contestant. Conventionally, the shortlisted candidates are then invited for an interview about their procedure and method of finding the vulnerability. This adds an extra step and increases cost due to human engagement. We aim to develop a better CTF platform where various upgrades like more accurate leaderboard with better score calculation formula and ways to reduce and simplify selection procedure by introducing features such as write-ups.

articleTitle: The Fusion of Bearing and Frequency Measurements from Multi-sensor Arrays for Underwater Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Estimation is the process of generating information that is not directly available from raw measurements to obtain different target motion parameters. To fulfil this aim, different measurements from various sensors are fused to obtain a more accurate and reliable estimate of the target state. This task is more complex when the sensors operate in passive mode. In this research work, passive measurements i.e., bearings from an array mounted on the hull (HMA) and array sensors towed behind the observer along with doppler shifted frequency measurements from the towed array are fused to obtain kinematic parameters of the desired target. The sub-optimal filter, Unscented Kalman filter is considered for the performance analysis. The results are compared to that of simple doppler-bearing tracking using measurements from HMA. The simulation is carried in MATLAB software using the Monte-Carlo simulation method for better analysis of the results.

articleTitle: An Emission Estimation of Rocket Engine Using Matlab Software
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Combustion unsteadiness is prompted by the coupling impact of the insecure hotness arrival of the ignition interaction and the adjustment of the acoustic tension in the gas complex of the burning chamber. This is analysis is estimated through MATLAB 2015b software tool Such dangers can create different issues in the burning framework like helpless productivity, untimely corruption of parts, and surprisingly a cataclysmic disappointment of the framework. Burning shakiness is a significant issue in plan of gas turbine combustors for proficient activity with low emanations. An exchange framework based methodology is created in this work for the strength examination of gas turbine combustors. By review the combustor cavity as a one-dimensional acoustic framework with a side branch, the hotness source situated inside the pit can be depicted as the contribution to the framework. The burning system is displayed as a shut circle input framework, which empowers usage of grounded exemplary control hypotheses for the security investigation. Because of the innate benefit of the exchange lattice technique and control framework portrayal, displaying and examination of the framework turns into a clear assignment in any event, for a combustor of the complicated math. The simulations results are applied to the solidness examination of a straightforward ignition framework to show its legitimacy and viability. CFD examination to decide the pressure, velocity, heat transfer rate, heat transfer coefficient, acoustic power and emissions (O2, Co2 and H2O) at various Mach numbers 3,5,8 and at various fluent castor biodiesel, methanol and ethanol.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Data Analysis using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The COVID-19 epidemic began in Wuhan, China and has now expanded to the majority of a world’s nations. The propagation of a pandemic is primarily determined according to each country’s policies and social responsibilities. As per the WHO, the attack rate for 23 June 2020 is estimated to be between 1.4 and 2.5. In comparison to industrialized nations, India’s position is rather manageable. It would be fascinating to learn about the facts and data surrounding corona cases throughout India. On world meters, many forms of data are provided. We aimed to assess similar information for India and created several predictions on the impacted rate, daily new cases, and daily total completed cases, among others. COVID-19 has cruelly stopped everything within civilization. An examination of COVID-19 records to determine which age groups are the most affected by the virus. Various Machine learning is used to develop predictive model. Algorithms as well as their related performance data are calculated and analysed. Regressor Random Forest and Random Forest The classification algorithm beat all other machine learning algorithm. such as Support Vector Machine, KNN+, Neighbourhood Component Analysis, decision tree classification, and Gaussian Classifier naive Bayesian, Multi linear Regression, various Logistic Classifiers based on the regression technique and the Extreme Gradient Boosting algorithm.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection using Keras, Opencv and Tensorflow by Implementing Mobilenetv2
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The pandemic of Corona Virus Disease (COVID-19) is triggering a public health emergency. Wearing a face mask is one of the most important ways to combat the infection. Face mask identification is discussed in the article, and it can be used by authorities to enable COVID-19 avoidance, assessment, prevention, and action plans. In this project, we developed a deep learning model to detect the presence of a mask on a person. We have trained it using Keras and OpenCV. The image classification method: MobilenetV2 is used to speed up the training time and we use approx. 2000 images to train the model.

articleTitle: Ardino based IoT Smart Parking System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In our daily existence we are facing one of the most unavoidable tasks i.e., parking the car wherever we go, as our need will increase our journeying will increase however because of drastic growth in utilization of motors and growth in population, we are facing the hard venture of parking our vehicle especially in the course of busiest hours of the day. With respect to the quantity of population, the usage of private motors additionally increased, because of extra use of automobiles the traffic congestion taking place at the road, most of the people chooses non-public motors than public transportation, in the course of the frenzy hours to discover parking area in maximum metropolitan regions, industrial regions may be very difficult, time eating and regularly pricey in nearly each large town to discover right and stable parking area. Parking car in metropolitan towns has created havoc certainly that has created a prime trouble to park their motors in specified location which leaves the consumer to look for their parking. Here We have proposed an appropriate way to this trouble, the system that we propose right here with the aid of usage of ultrasonic sensors, Arduino Uno board and login portal, those made a massive effect on studying and offers actual time records concerning availability of parking slots in a parking area, this model resolves the problem of parking system and has provides with IOT (Internet of Things) enabled parking system. This smart parking system grants data to human beings locating a parking area online. It overcomes useless time eating for locating the trouble of parking area in parking regions. This login portal might be available via an application/internet site portal in which customers can view diverse parking regions and pick out the gap from available slots. This allows interplay among smart parking system and the consumer.

articleTitle: Prognosis of Human Epidermal Malignancy: A Machine learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Malignancy is tendency of medical condition to progressively become fatal and generally refers to the presence of cancerous cells with the ability to spread or to invade, and destroy tissues. Malignancy can start from any three layers of the epidermis, the probability of malignancy is upraised in those people where melanin pigment availability is genetically less. Increasing cases of malignant cancer have attracted researchers to find new approaches for their identification, and characterization. Various research studies have used Picture filtering and Computer’s vision that segregate malignancy into broadly seven category but Machine learning neural network models has a considerable advantage in clinical dermatology as these utilize VGGNet16, ResNet50, and CNN models. These models are applied for high-quality images with 128x128 and 256x256 resolution on HAM (HUMAN Against Machine) data sets having 10000 images. This approach focuses on the prediction of any classified skin malignancy taking patient image as a processing input. The commercial application will not only shorten the cost of the treatment but will also provide quick results for large population (around 3 million people) globally.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: COVID-19 is one of the most dangerous forms of diseases which is caused by corona virus. It is a highly transmissible disease. WHO has already declared it as a pandemic .Therefore at the current scenario, due to outbreak of this pandemic (COVID-19), face masks has become the necessary tool of everyone to avoid spread of disease to some extent. There has been a great demand for the development of software which can easily recognize person who is wearing a mask. Therefore we are going to develop a system which will fulfill the need using Deep Learning . We will use convolutional neural network to train our model. Here two categories of dataset will be used. The one which contains set of images of faces with mask and the other without face masks We will train the program with this data set to learn to decide whether a person’s face is masked or not. OpenCV, tensorflow and keras will be used for the real time face detection with live stream through web camera. After the successful deployment of the product, we will be able to design a software which can be installed at various places such as at the entry gate of colleges, railway stations ,air ports ,temples, hotels and shops etc. This will easily detect the persons who are entering without face masks by using cameras of the systems. Hence this product is the need of the hour for us to develop so as to work for the safety of humans.

articleTitle: Human Mobility based Pandemic Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In December 2019, the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) outbreak was first reported in Wuhan, China, and later has expanded all over India and across the world. The dynamics of pandemic spatial spread have gotten a lot of interest among researchers. Human mobility on a huge scale has increased the transmission of the epidemic. This paper offers a prediction model for coronavirus cases based on epidemic data and population mobility data. The study integrates the human mobility data with the historical cases to predict future COVID-19 cases. The findings indicate that population mobility may adequately explain the spread of coronavirus. The effectiveness of our proposed model is demonstrated by the coefficient of determination-R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with the prediction value of 0.962. The proposed model can be used as a resource for epidemic prevention and control decision support.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Intrusion detection using a feedback System: Study
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the growth and expansion of network technologies, every corner of the world is now connected and people are using the Internet to a great extent. As an eternal truth, every growth brings many challenges along with it. Some challenges over the Internet are security, availability, speed, congestion, etc. Among all major threats, security is most important and must be dealt with a lot of attention and accuracy. Security measures applied must work on time (real-time) and must not cause a lot of delays in the processing of data. For security over the Internet, Intrusion Detection techniques are being used prominently. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) process every incoming and outgoing data packet from the system whether a particular machine or a network. Hence it requires working with huge of data that not only contains the information linked to security threats but can also learn from them and apply it for all future traffic. This work provides an IDS with machine learning to process large data of IP packets.

articleTitle: Offline Handwritten Word Recognition of Devanagari Script
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As we know that, recognizing words manually from a large handwritten document is a tedious task and challenging as it has different styles and strokes between characters. So, a system is needed to recognize words written in Devanagari script from documents via digitization or image processing techniques. So, for classification of words from documents either online or offline, different methods have been surveyed till now, then a new system can be utilized in an efficient way. This paper presents comparative detailed study of various techniques and work done by researchers in context of Devanagari script.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology in Forensic Science. A Bibliometric Review
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blockchain technology in forensic science can have meaningful changes and improvements in digital forensics, forensic investigation, evidence management, and chain of evidence. The consolidation of research on the application of blockchain technology on forensic management, basing Scopus database was conducted and the research trends of bibliometric analysis were visualized. The prominent funding agencies, leading research organizations, authors, countries, journals, and keywords were mentioned in this research. The future scope of research on this research domain can be on enhancing the privacy, authenticity, reliability, and evidence handling in forensic science by the implementation of blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Concept Drift Detection for Social Media: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The research over information retrieval from social media data has progressed for streaming data since the last decade. Recently, academic researchers have witnessed users' changing topics, trends, and intent on social media. This change of information with time takes into account the temporal attribute for real-time data, and thus, advances in this domain are exponentially growing. Although concept drift is still not explored due to a shortage of available datasets, concept drift for social media is minimally explored. This manuscript makes attempts to identify the types of concept drift for social media data, discuss the historical perspective of concept drift on social media, and enlist the possible research directions.

articleTitle: A Modified Data Clustering Algorithm for Uncertain Data in Peer to Peer Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A sensational rise of various applications and businesses has led to the rise of data being collected, it is getting harder to store this data on a single machine. It has become more feasible to manage dispersed data sets and organizations. That is the reason distributed data mining methods have become popular. Perhaps the main hurdle of data mining is to perform data clustering. While many clustering calculations exist for certain and uncertain data sets, there is need of productive calculations for distributed data sets. In this paper, a modified hierarchical clustering algorithm is proposed for uncertain dataset to improve timing in execution of the process.

articleTitle: Comparison of Various Classifiers for Movie Data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentimental analysis is a subset of opinion mining where we study the emotion/feeling/opinion of the sentence of the people about specific matters from structured,. In this, we try to analyze on IMDB movie review dataset. we inspect the sentiment manner to classify the polarity of the movie review on a range of 0 to 1 i.e. 0 beings (highly disliked) to 1(highly liked) by excluding the stop word. Since human opinion amplifies the coherence of a product, the overall performance of a movie depends on how people react to it which would be in the form of reviews. Due to the variety of sentiments available in the movie scripts we choose this as our dataset, the term "emotional charge'' is best suitable for the movies as they tend to emotionally charge a person’s mindset. Though we didn’t take a large dataset to define the purpose it best suited the agenda to compare a variety of algorithms.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In Stock Market Prediction, the aim is to predict the longer term price of the monetary stocks of an organization. The recent trend available market prediction technologies is that the use of machine learning that makes predictions supported the values of current exchange indices by coaching on their previous values. Machine learning itself employs completely different models to create expectation simpler and legitimate. The paper centers around the work of Regression and LSTM principally based Machine figuring out how to foresee stock qualities. Variables pondered region unit open, close, low, high and volume. In a financially volatile market, because the exchange, it's vital to own a really precise prediction of a future trend. as a result of the monetary crisis and marking profits it's important to possess a safe expectation of the upsides of the stocks. Anticipating a non-straight sign requirements progressed calculations of AI. The writing contains concentrates with totally extraordinary AI calculations like ANN (counterfeit neural organizations) with various element decision. The consequences of this examination can show that the algorithmic principle of grouping SVM (Support Vector Machines) with the help of highlight decision PCA (Principal part investigation) can have the accomplishment of building a benefit.

articleTitle: A Faster Optimal Solution for Economic Dispatch Problem in A Smart Grid Environment using Tensorflow
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper has a description of an approach that is apt for generating the solution of classical Economic Dispatch (ED) problem in a smart grid environment. There is a need for designing newer set of machine learning algorithms which can be applied for smart grid applications in cloud computing and bigdata specific situations. There are numerous advantages that are offered by a cloud computing environment, which must be addressed in a suitable manner to apply these techniques in a smart grid application. Big-data application is identified by a huge volume, velocity, variety and veracity. This paper gives a description of a scheme that can generate a simplified solution of the classical ED problem in a smart grid environment. The implementation of the scheme is done using tensor-flow. Since the classical model of ED is simplified in the final state by this scheme, this method is bound to generate a faster solution when it is implemented online. A simple sample system is used to show the implementation of the proposed scheme based on tensor-flow.

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Social Networks Using Node Embeddings with Nature Inspired Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Social networks are important for tasks such as transmitting information, predicting the outcomes of an event, and predicting new relationships. The link prediction task involves the prediction of new relationships that may be created over time. More formally, suppose we have a social network’s snapshot at the current time, we are interested in accurately predicting the edges that are not currently present but will be present after some time has elapsed. A new approach, Nature Inspired using CC-CD, has been proposed in this paper which makes use of node embeddings and closeness centrality. We have used the cosine distances of node embeddings as a proxy of distances and Closeness Centrality as a proxy of masses in Newton’s Gravitational Law for prediction of new links.

articleTitle: A study on Geotextile Strengthening Analysis using Python Software
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the current trend, materials have been extensively utilized within the applications of civil engineering for reinforce roads, retaining walls, railway ballasts and highways. Hence, focusing on interaction of geotextile under direct shear is prominent. Soil reinforcement interaction has a significant role in reinforced soil design procedure. The qualities of the soil, the reinforcement, and the interplay of the components are all important in this process. In this manuscript, shear strength interface among sand and geotextiles having diversified strength has been characterized by the direct shear tests. Moreover, the direct shear test series are approved for examining the behaviour of soil or geosynthetics interface. Also, geotextile has been kept at distinct position in the shear-box, while its impacts are examined consequently. Further, properties of geosynthetics, soils, and test equipment are explored. The internal friction angle (Ø); Cohesion (C) and behaviour of shear of sand geotextile interference have been explored by examining the experimental outcomes from the tests.

articleTitle: Wireless Communication Using Visible Light Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The number of gadgets accessing the internet is increasing every day in a world of wireless technologies. The majority of devices use wireless connection to access the internet and share data, which has unfortunately increased network complexity and increased the risk of radio frequency interference. This has resulted in a significant decrease in available spectrum for future devices. We should seek out an alternative medium that provides both high bandwidth and security. We should seek out an alternative medium that provides both high bandwidth and security. In terms of transmission speed, security, and usability, the visible spectrum represents a completely new paradigm in wireless technology, comes to mind when we think about such criteria. This project describes and implements a transmission system for audio and data using the visible spectrum as medium I.e., By fast and precise variations in the light intensity by a controlled current of the LED, data is transmitted from transmitter to receiver using visible light as a medium and a photo diode senses the variations at the receiver end which is controlled using ARM microcontroller.

articleTitle: GUI Information System Based Flood Detection Using Gaussian Distance Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper an advanced satellite images and spectral coefficients are disusing with remote sensing. The multispectral images are analyzed through Normalized Support Vector Machine. The flood regions are analyzed through satellite devices with spectral coefficients. The earlier models are unable to get information; the following limitations are overcome through SVM model. The modified SVM is classifies the satellite images with good tracking. The measures like accuracy 93.43%, sensitivity 95.34%, and Recall 97.12% had been attained. The SVM and MSVM models are giving more accurate outcomes. The methodology is outperformance the experimental results. The remote sensing applications are more accurate compared to conventional models.

articleTitle: Road Extraction from High-Resolution Satellite Images using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Data Extraction has always been one of the major interests of several companies and government agencies for obtaining information through satellite images. The Data extraction in the form of road extraction from satellite images has played a very important part in navigation, military, national security, agriculture, and understanding the geology of the earth’s surface. We are introducing ReLU as the classification function, with the soft-max function. In this paper, we present an automated model for road extraction from a high-resolution satellite image. Here, we are implementing Rectified Linear Unit through Segmentation for obtaining roads out of satellite images with pre-processing, training, and validation of input data. And re-define the quality aspect of satellite images.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Based Mouse With Color Detection Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this research paper, we have used computer vision technology for the development of interaction between computers and humans. This technology can act as an interface between computers and humans. Nowadays, everyone uses mouse and keyboards to interact with computers. This traditional approach of interaction is costly as well as not a user-friendly approach. In this paper, we propose a computer vision-based mouse with a color detection technique that uses a web camera of our computer to detect the color pointer and accordingly it perform the various mouse functions on the screen. This developed approach of performing different mouse functions can reduce the hardware cost of the computer and make it user-friendly for everyone.

articleTitle: GPS Positioning Performance Analysis under St. Patrick's Day 2015 Geomagnetic Storm Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The geomagneticstorm isaspace weather phenomenon that severely affects GPS positioning and satellite nd HF communications links. The GPS radio-wave signalspropagating through the ionosphere are vulnerable due to geomagnetic storms. A severe geomagnetic storm(the St. Patrick's Day storm) occurred on 17-18 March 2015. In this paper, GPS positional errors are obtained using RTKLIB software and ground-based GPS data collected for the three Indian low latitude GPS stations Hyderabad(Latitude: 17.47°N, Longitude: 78.57°E) and Lucknow(Latitude: 26.76° N, Longitude:80.88° E).The GP positioning errors are prominent during the geomagnetic storm days Mar 16 and Mar 18 2015. A two-fold positioning error of 23 meters is noticed on Mar 17 2015 compared to pre-storm day GPS positioning error(12m). The outcome of this work would help in understanding thespace weather effects on GPS positional performance.

articleTitle: Review On Energy Efficiency Protocol In Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The research community has spent the last ten years focusing on resource data routing in wireless communication. Sensor nodes have built a name for themselves in a number of industries, although sensor nodes are battery-operated and have a limited lifespan. As a result, while designing routing protocols, the primary goal is to reduce energy consumption and increase the network's lifetime. In this post, we've looked at routing protocols in depth, with a focus on prolonging network lifetime. We provided a variety of routing protocols to help students obtain a full comprehension of a research. This included investigation, energy, observation, as well as a combination of these, as well as addressed publications. Thereafter, a quantitative examination is employed to determine the strengths and weaknesses of the articles, following by a functionality analysis to get a quick understanding of the modeling approaches. This review article focus on the renewable energy for Sensor nodes by offering an overview of alternative approaches to the same aim and arranging them by usefulness.

articleTitle: Web Based Online Blood Donation System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper depicts a high level program to close the hole between blood givers and individuals needing blood. The Online Blood donation Administration Framework application is an approach to synchronize blood donation centers with emergency clinics with the assistance of the Web. It is a web application where enlisted clinics can check the accessibility of the necessary Blood and can send a blood solicitation to the closest blood donation center or comparable contributor as per the blood and can be controlled online through where fundamental. Blood donation center can likewise send a solicitation to another blood donation center that isn't accessible. Anybody willing to give blood can be found at the closest blood donation center utilizing the Android Bank The executives Framework. Blood donation center can be followed utilizing maps. The Android application is simply accessible to benefactors to look for blood gifts and ask blood donation centers and clinics to search out blood donation centers and close by givers.

articleTitle: AMC backed Hysteresis Shaped Monopole Antenna for Wi-Fi, WiMAX, and IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper describes a coplanar waveguide wide band antenna with a reverse hysteresis curve shaped artificial magnetic conductor with three operational bands and enhanced gain. The main antenna consists of a coplanar waveguide feed and stepped rectangular patch with a triangular cut at the middle. Design consists of both main antenna and artificial magnetic conductor, where artificial magnetic conductor is placed below the main antenna which enhances the gain. The gain enhancement is the major objective of this analysis. The main antenna works at 3.4GHz-5.86GHz, 10.28GHz-11.86GHz & 13.69GHz-14.28GHz. After placing the artificial magnetic conductor, it works at 3.19GHz-6.05GHz, 10.27GHz- 11.77GHz & 13.79GHz-14.36GHz. The gain after placing the artificial magnetic conductor is greater or equal to 1.2 times of the main antenna. The bandwidth has been increased lesser frequencies. Total analysis of main antenna in both the cases of artificial magnetic conductor is described in this paper. The antenna proposed works for different applications such as Wi-Fi, WI-Max, and IOT.

articleTitle: Analysis of Image Generation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
