abstract: With a growing appearance of enormous cases of COVID-19 in people, computational solutions founded on deep learning can play a huge role in performing automated prediction of the corona virus disease. In this article a hybrid deep convolution neural network architecture named as CompDNet-512 is implemented to detect the presence of COVID disease in the chest radiographs of patients. Previously the researchers had only used deep transfer learning technique for train neural network model to detect the syndrome. They have succeeded to some extent, but none were able to developed generalized model which can be predicting various abnormalities present in clinical images. Herein, our model can be applied to range of medical application for abnormalities prediction. The proposed model is a combination of three techniques that is, lossless compression, dense network and progressive resizing, which when applied in a pipeline to the chest X-ray dataset consisting of positive corona virus patient studies and normal studies, outperformed the existing models in detecting COVID-19 and shown an accuracy of 98.3 %.

articleTitle: Sink Hole Attack Detection using Two Step Verification Technique in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: WSN (wireless sensor network) is the decentralized kind of network that has no centralized controller is present for the data transmission. As this network is dynamic, the entry of malicious nodes is allowed in the network which can trigger sink hole attack in the network. In the sink hole attack malicious pretend itself to be base station and start receiving data packets of the network. In this research work, two-step scheme is introduced to detect the malicious nodes. In the first step, it will confirm that malicious node is existed in the network. The second phase emphasizes on detecting the malicious node from the network. NS2 is utilized to execute the introduced technique. Diverse parameters such as throughput, packet loss and delay are considered for analyzing the results. This depicted that proposed scheme give high performance as compared to existing scheme to detect the malicious nodes from the network.

articleTitle: IoT Based Remote Patient Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As the population of elder and bedridden people are increasing day by day so the care taking demands are also tremendously increasing everyday. Hence patient health assisting systems are grasping importance nowadays. This paper demonstrates regular monitoring of patients not only the bedridden but in whole monitoring of all the patients which do need assistance. We have designed and developed an energy efficient, reliable economically efficient and easily available patient monitoring system, It is able to capture and report real time data related to patients effectively. It empower the doctors and other medical assistants to examine patient’s health parameters (temp, heartbeat, ECG, position) in actual time and also it works in two way process that is not only Doctors or Medical assistants would be able to give assistance but also patient’s guardians will be able to suggest anything they want to suggest the system that is to be proposed for the irregular patient health will be regularly and time to time monitoring the vitals of the organs using different sensors are initially associated with the patient physically or virtually, further connecting them to the Arduino board. Also, in this paper, we have highlighted the various challenges associated with the implementation of IoT in systems involving health monitoring working in real time.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Maximum Power Point Tracking Algorithms Applied to Hybrid Wind and Solar System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In present situation the availability of fossil fuels like coal, diesel and uranium etc, very low and power generation is not possible a lot more by using these fossil fuels due to this the generation of electricity from renewable energy sources such as solar and wind has surged. This work presents the modeling, simulation, a hybrid model of wind-solar system using PI and MPPT controllers was evaluated for performance and compared. A WT (wind turbine) is the heart of the wind power producing system, a Synchronous Permanent Magnet Generator (PMSG), a current-regulated PWM voltage source inverter, which is a three-phase regulated system with a PI controller, can control the performance of a bridge rectifier. The solar system simulation model incorporates the impacts solar energy is evolving irradiance as well as temperature, and the MPPT controller is used to achieve maximum output from PV cells. In this paper discussed evolution of wind/photovoltaic power systems and also how this MPPT techniques efficiently working to obtain maximum power from PV cells and to obtain uninterrupted power supply to the load. As well there are different types of MPPT strategies are using for supplying power to the load in a Wind-Solar Hybrid system, including P&O (Perturb & Observe), conductance incremental performance (INC), and Rule based MPPT with fuzzy logic controllers. Various MPPT approaches are used to simulate the results of a hybrid system.

articleTitle: Outlier Analysis Based Intrusion Detection for IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the world becoming more and more advanced in technology, every section of our society is dependent on computers and internet. Many interactions, data storage and data retrieval takes place over the internet. And with so many interactions comes the need to secure this data. Many researchers have built the Intrusion Detection Systems for the same. Many networks exist. One such network is of IoT. Furthermore, Internet of Things (IoT) is a fast growing network in which objects interact with other objects via the Internet. And IDSs are also required to protect such objects from unauthorised access and other vulnerabilities. So many physical objects including cars, refrigerators, watches, household objects, etc. interact with one another. There is high scope of expansion of such network in future and new attacks will come forward. For such new attacks, new Intrusion detection approaches will be explored. Here we explore some existing IDSs for IoT. We have also done comparative analysis of different IDSs for IoT based on different features like placement strategy, type, attacks handled, etc. Then we implemented 2 well know attacks, DIS attack and Version attack, on Cooja to study their impact on the network by analysing power consumption values of the nodes. Through statistical analysis and outlier detection we found out how a malicious node affects other nodes in the network.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Computer Controlled Thermal Spraying on Hot Corrosion Control of Boiler Tube Steels
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The surface degradation due to hot corrosion and erosion in thermal power plants is one of the primary concerns for many researchers. Hot corrosion is considered as a serious problem in coal-based thermal power plants which fulfill approximately 58.3 % requirement of the total electricity demand of India. The practice of using low-grade fuels at high functional temperatures is the overriding reason of accelerated hot corrosion. A case study stated that out of 89 boiler failures 50 boiler failures occur in a year, due to hot corrosion. This leads to reduced economical efficiency of the thermal power plants. This problem cannot be eliminated completely but it can be controlled to some extent. Surface modification is one of the effective methods to enhance the life of boiler components. For Minimise the economical loss and probability of premature failure of the engineering components different researchers investigated and concluded that those different computer-controlled coating processes are helpful to enhance the lifespan of different engineering components. In this study, we will discuss performance analysis of different computer-controlled thermal spraying process. We will review the effects of various types of the thermal spray processes such as plasma spray, HVOF and D-gun, to develop the corrosion resistance surface properties on different substrate materials.

articleTitle: A Survey on Security Challenges and Defending Methods in Cloud Based Internet of Things Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: IoT devices are able to sense real world like lighting, temperature, presence or absence of objects or people and report that real world data also able to act accordingly. Popular examples of Internet of Things (IoT) devices are Surveillance cameras, refrigerators, smart-televisions, washing machines etc. But many vulnerabilities are found in IoT network. New security challenges and issues are introduced because of resource constrained IoT devices as well as the various components involved in the development of such a systems. Providing security services for securing these types of network and avoiding the vulnerabilities is not so easy. Hence it is very important to improve the existing security methodologies which will be helpful in IoT network security.

articleTitle: A review on Big Data Privacy and Security Techniques for the Healthcare Records
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Big Data has become a hot topic of research and has been used in every industry. Healthcare industry has many benefits both in terms of revenue and data. Electronic medical records are used by doctors to record and track the health metrics and information of their patients. An EMR is an Electronic Collection of medical information such as diagnosis, prescriptions, examinations, allergies, immunizations and recovery plans about the health history of a patient. Medical care providers working with a patient can see electronic health records and can use them to make decisions about the patient’s care. As electronic health records have many advantages; the security becomes the main challenge. Different methods that have been used for healthcare data security have been reviewed to make this complex information more secure.We shall present a detailed review of various challenges of big data and present various methods and techniques to secure and protect healthcare records in this paper. This review will provide information on security and privacy strategies and procedures in healthcare to a number of users.

articleTitle: Farmers Agriculture Assistance Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: India is known for the apprehension of global powerhouse of agriculture in the world and has been mainly an agriculture-based economy, in spite of the fact that a lot of farmers and respective individuals face a lot of problems in agriculture due to inadequate knowledge of agriculture production such as poor farming techniques, inadequate materials for the crop, proper crop planning, maintaining of fertilizer balance. This project represents a prototype of a chatbot structure which helps assist individuals or farmers in crop management and predicts the need of the crop. Prediction such as the fertilizer dosage, nutrients in the crop and assists in providing sufficient knowledge to the individual to work on the basic needs. This structure uses Natural Language Processing and takes feed from the predetermined data to give responses on based queries. For the Structure to be accurate the chatbot analyzes factors such as past feed and the sources of the data from "The Indian Council of Agricultural Research"

articleTitle: A Novel Analysis of SRM Drive System For Speed & Flux Control By An Advanced ARNN Control Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Present day many industries use reluctance motor for having low-cost modest construction with high rotation ripples and White noise associated by SRM drives with major issues. So, for this reason we need to reduce losses caused while operating motor control. In order to reduce the ripple torque, here develop a differential control strategies like switch reluctance motor (SWRM) which is excited separately and by doubly-salient rechargeable mechanism has features of rotation manufacture due to adjustable magnetic flux and the next one is artificial neural network (ARNN) and fuzzy with increased activity in intelligent control method that is suitable for SRM applications. This research examines various controllers for switch reluctance motors. ARNN Technique is used to estimate the stator current and flux. To create gating signals, the ARNN controller employs a vector control and switching table approach. For SRM fixed parameters, MATLAB/Simulink is utilized. The ARNN model has the advantage of requiring no prior knowledge (replica or equation) It was shown that the neural network estimator performed well in drive system simulations and had a more aptitude to approximate the SRM angles for motors processes in both linear and nonlinear areas, both with and without loads.

articleTitle: An Innovative Approach to Predict early Stage Depression using Mobile Network Usage
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This article introduces an early-stage depression identification technique without a physical presence in the medical unit. Currently used methods do not provide any early-stage depression detection techniques and require continuous investigation to diagnose depression. In general, depression detection is based on changes in human behavior. Changes in human behavior are also reflected in his/her mobile usage pattern. Mobile usage can correlate with human behavior and predict early-stage depression based on artificial intelligence (AI). The mobile usage data collected (e.g. location, activity, phone usage) can be used for effective depression screening. The proposed approach suggests using the user’s mobile usage pattern and applying machine learning algorithms to identify the change in mobile usage patterns over time. The machine learning algorithm like Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) can be effectively used to identify the change in pattern. This change in mobile usage pattern is then used to detect if the user is slowly moving into depression and warn the individual or concerned authority to handle the case.

Author Keywords: Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise

articleTitle: Management of Encrypted Data and De-Duplication of Big Data in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing is the accessibility of computer resources which includes storing of data and power to compute the data, when there is a demand of it for several applications. It is used to represent the data centers to users in the end over the Internet. The user cannot directly manage it actively. The challenging problem is the integrity of outsourced data. The encryption and decryption of data must be secure to overcome this problem. Here we use MD5 encryption algorithm to secure the outsourced data. Data replication is avoided by using de-duplication technique; thus the efficiency of memory storage is enhanced and time for processing is minimized.

articleTitle: Web Browser Forensics for Retrieving Searched Keywords on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays, most of the reported cybercrimes use the Internet. It is seen that Web Browsers leave forensically sound footprints of Internet browsing activities on the computer’s storage media. The traces once retrieved stand as crucial hints that help the investigator to reconstruct various events that the suspect has done. However, the usage of private or portable web browsers prevents the creation of those files on the Suspect’s Computer. This makes the job of investigators more challenging. But, the remnants of browsing activities done using any web browser is recorded in the Physical Memory of the Computer. Hence, analyzing the Physical Memory Dump of the suspect's machine, collected as part of Live Forensics, may provide lots of forensically sound evidence related to the Internet-related activities in a cybercrime investigation. This information provides highly crucial information which can render hints in the investigation process. One of the most important features of any Cyber Forensics Analysis Tool is keyword searching. But identifying and finalizing the keywords to be searched during the analysis process in a particular Cyber Crime is always challenging for the investigators. The task of retrieving searched keywords is crucial as it directly provides the criminal background of the Suspect if any. This information enables cyber forensics investigators to conduct a focused approach while analyzing the evidence. This paper mainly presents a novel methodology for the reconstruction of searched keywords from the Physical Memory Dump collected from the Suspect’s Windows 10 Computers. A methodology for retrieving keywords from the browser files generated by Web Browsers in the storage media has also been described. The keywords retrieved in this way helps the Investigators to identify the associated highly crucial information during the deep-dive analysis of the storage media in Offline Forensic Analysis.

articleTitle: An Advanced Agriculture IoT Technology with Wireless Application
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Design, development and manufacturing of a robot that can dig, plant and leveling mud are all proposed in this study paper. A sprayer will be used to provide moisture. Batteries and solar panels provide electricity for the whole robotic. More than 40% of the world’s population selects agriculture as their primary vocation, and the development of autonomous cars in agriculture has sparked significant interest in recent years. Through the use of an IR sensor, the vehicle is controlled by a relay switch. The language input allows a user to interact with a robot that most people are familiar with. Hands-free and quick data input activities are two advantages of these robots. In the field of agricultural autonomous vehicles, a concept has been developed to investigate whether multiple tiny autonomous robots might outperform conventional big tractors and humans efforts. A device with the following features has been created with the above ideology in mind. The IoT with wireless applications providing accurate outcomes for generating crop production.

articleTitle: Monitoring And Controlling Of IoT Based Solar Wind Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As the demand for non-conventional recourses is increasing every day. It is necessary to increase the power production and installation of non-conventional power plants. It is not economical. It explains a combination of solar and wind systems called a solar wind hybrid system, power monitoring and controlling. Present Windmills and solar plants have several obstacles. Many wind farms are far from power using regions and the solar plant requires occupies more space; tracking these farms are difficult to manage and maintain. Wind farms could be built deepinside of the sea, possibly between mountains or in the forests. When small defects arise, employees are needed to travel to certain places to clear the fault. It necessitates a large amount of manpower, time, and is fraught with financial difficulties. Similar techniques are used to take readings of a specific plant.The IOT concept can be used to resolve these limitations. For data logging, most current products use a memory card or a computer. This knowledge is most easily accessible on personal computer. IoT may also help with this problem. A low-cost monitoring and control system is proposed in this paper for wind turbines and solar plants, as well as a statistic logging feature. Any of the parameters of windmill plants, such aswith these proposed devices, power generation, magnitude, voltage and currents, humidity and temperature can all be regulated and used anywhere in the world.

articleTitle: Ranking of Reliability Models based on Accurate Estimation and Weighted Function
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Many software reliability models have been developed and are in use extensively. Because of advancements in technology, no single model gives optimal results for all applications; therefore, selecting the best model for a particular application always remains an area of interest. This paper uses different computational methods using various weighted functions to determine models' ranking. A set of thirteen comparison criteria using observed value and an estimation value of models has been formulated. We assess the model's suitability in estimating the fault by calculating model rank based on various factors. We developed a ranking model that takes into account the weightage of the model ranks in all individual comparison criteria and incorporates the estimation capability of a model through a weighted estimation function.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Traffic Signs Identification Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays using technology, the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML). Autonomous vehicles will become a reality on our roads shortly. However, driver requires technical solutions for a range of issues. It's anything but a magnificent commitment to the auto business, which is going towards development and monetary development. Assume we are discussing some previous decade. All things considered, the energy of new examination and the world is currently at the exceptionally progressed phase of the mechanical transformation: We will fabricate a profound neural organization model that can characterize traffic signs present in the picture into various classifications. This model we have tried and brought about 90% precision.

articleTitle: A CNN and LSTM-based Data Prediction Model for WSN
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Due to the limited energy, the growth in network size and sensory data causes a slew of severe issues for wireless sensor networks. Data prediction methods are useful for reducing network traffic and increasing network lifespan, particularly when data correlation across sensory data is explored. In the event that these sensor nodes fail, data prediction may be utilised to retrieve aberrant or lost data. Current wireless sensor network prediction techniques do not fully use the spatial-temporal relationship between remote sensor hubs, resulting in greater prediction error. In a wireless sensor network, this article offers a new approach for multi step sensory data prediction. To begin, we present ANN (artificial neural networks) based on 1-D CNN that use pre-processed sensory input to extract abstract characteristics of various qualities. Then, using these abstract characteristics, one-step prediction is obtained. Finally, by repeatedly utilising chronicled information and the forecast outcomes of the preceding phase, the multi-step expectation is presented. The suggested multi-step prescient model can foresee multi step (mid and short term) tactile information after choosing appropriate hub mixes in which the spatial-fleeting connection is emphasised, according to experiment findings, and its performance is superior than other similar approach.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Measurements Fusion for Passive Target Tracking in Underwater
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The pivot goal of estimation algorithms is to generate information with a quality higher than that of raw measurements available and to extract the information that can be obtained indirectly from the available measurements. To fulfill this aim, the measurements from multiple sensors are combined to get a more accurate and reliable estimate of the target. In this research work, measurements from five multiple sensors are combined to get different motion parameters of the desired target. The sub-optimal filter, Unscented Kalman filter is considered for the performance analysis of the algorithm. The simulation is carried in MATLAB software using the Monte-Carlo simulation method for better analysis of the results.

articleTitle: Specific Structure Building Extraction from High Resolution Satellite Image
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Building extraction is a key research area under the remote sensing community. These analyses are done using aerial and satellite images. Many algorithms have been designed for building extraction and deals with various situation of images like their resolution, different environmental conditions etc… This work focuses not only on building extraction but it also extracts the specific building shapes which can be useful for different societal purposes. In this work, Unet based deep learning model has been used for the predicting the building masks and then few post processing steps applied for extracting specific shape building structures. The work uses WHU building dataset which contains 204 images with varying resolution from 0.3m to 2.5m of 512x512 dimensions. The result shows the specific shape of each extracted building.

articleTitle: Electronic Payments based on Blockchain Technology. A Bibliometric Review
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The conventional electronic payment systems are facing challenges on ensuring, safety, trust and accuracy. These issues can be addressed in blockchain technology. The bibliometric patterns of research on blockchain technology and electronic payments shows the domination of China, Chinese authors and China based Universities in the research. China was followed by United States of America. The leading journals were IEEE Access and the Lecture Notes in Computer Science. The future research can be on widening the application of blockchain technology in electronic payments and future researchers can concentrate the documents and resources from China and United States of America for updating knowledge and for research collaborations.

articleTitle: Impact of Agile Scrum Methodology on Team’s Productivity and Client Satisfaction – A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Customer satisfaction is the primary goal of any software service provider in the long run. A small team dedicated to a short sprint handles a variety of challenges while providing deliverables to the client in agile software development. The customer, on the other hand, makes numerous decisions to get a design that meets market standard. In Agile software development, changes are organized into user stories for the sprint, developed in iterations and are reviewed by customers on regular intervals. Under the supervision of Scrum master, the teams work in back-to-back sprints to meet the sprints goals. Agile helps to deliver the end product in line to the client requirements but team might feel stressed out in the end-to-end process. This research paper presents the performance analysis of Agile Scrum methodology towards critical project parameters of Customer satisfaction and Team’s productivity.

articleTitle: Stock Market Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This project is based on the feature of python to access web data through different tools. We are using tools like NumPy, Pandas, etc. to access the web to retrieve the information related to the stock market. In this project, we will be taking a gander at information from the especially some technology stocks. We will utilize python packages to get stock data, envision various parts of it, lastly, we will take a gander at a couple of methods of dissecting the risk of a stock.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Low Energy Consumed Long Life Network (LECLLN) with Reliable Routing Protocol (RRP)
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The wireless sensor Networks facing many issues while transferring packets between the nodes and the major limitation is packet loss and the high energy consumption. The lifetime of the network is based on these parameters which can be controlled by using different cluster formations and different routing protocols. In this paper, there is an implementation of Low Energy Consumed Long Life Network (LECLLN) with Reliable Routing Protocol (RRP) which forms three different clusters with different cluster heads, which reduces the transmission energy and the probability of packet loss is drastically reduced and also it increases the life time of the network. The routing is based on the analysis done using the gathered information from the clusters which is called Reliable Routing Protocol (RRP). The energy consumption of the network based on the cluster size and the throughput variation is based on the length of the packets. The performance of the network can be evaluated by the energy consumption and the throughput with respect to the packet length.

Author Keywords: Low Energy Consumed Long Life Network (LECLLN)

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Defected Ground Circular Polarized Antenna for WLAN
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper, a microstrip patch antenna is designed for wireless local area network (WLAN) standard UNII worldwide/2C/2E of 255 GHz bandwidth. Antenna is designed using a rectangular radiating patch on FR-4 substrate with a mushroom shaped slot in the ground plane. Slot is etched to achieve wider 10-dB bandwidth and circular polarization. Proposed structure provides left hand circular polarization (LHCP) for the positive Z-plane. Simulated antenna is fabricated and tested to validate the results. Measured impedance bandwidth as well as 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth is sufficient to cover the desired WLAN band from 5.47 to 5.725GHz. Antenna shows good radiation characteristics with high gain of 4.12 dB and less than 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth for the entire band which makes it a suitable candidate for WLAN applications.

articleTitle: A Quick-Witted Cobweb for Enternet-Business Data Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Today we are living in the era where information is the key of getting success in the field of electronic business. Today’s business industry is ruled by information and internet. The developing areas of electronic business has its impact on the inflation and CPI(Consumer Price Index). Self-Driven or we can say that automatic quick-witted cobweb, data extractor or web scrappers are the software which we can use to wring out the information which is available on the online platform. In this paper we are going to proposed a scrapper which is based on a object oriented programming language which is very popular among us i.e. python. The main motive of our project is to make the information wrenching process very easy. In this process there are various steps which must be followed to get well cooked information.

articleTitle: Review on Machine Learning Techniques for International Trade Trends Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Now days, analyzing the past trend and make future predictions has become an important aspect for every field to growth. By analyzing the economic trends and knowing the future value of important economic variables makes a country more efficient in country’s economic planning and developing policies. This can be achieved by increased application of machine learning more effectively and accurately. In recent years, Machine Learning techniques have been suggested as alternative approach to traditional statistical methods by many authors in the field of economics. As international trade policies critically affects employment and wages of a country that is important aspect for growth of a country, for policy makers all across the world, predicting future patterns of international trade is a top priority. This paper presented a literature review of the works where machine-learning techniques have been used in international trade trends prediction. The findings reveal that there is a growing interest in developing machine learning models for economic forecasting in comparison to conventional statistical methods.

articleTitle: Metamaterial Inspired Soil Moisture Sensor Using Machine Learning Approach For Accurate Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this work, the design of a metamaterial-inspired soil moisture sensor is presented. A Broadside Coupled Circular Complementary Split-Ring Resonator (BC-CCSRR) topology is used in the design where the material under test (MUT) is placed between the resonators. The moisture content in a soil sample is determined by placing it as the MUT. To predict the moisture content in the soil accurately, a machine learning algorithm is utilized. The sensor design proposed is small, easy to fabricate, low cost, and the moisture content in the different soil types can be predicted with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Medical Image Processing from Large Datasets Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: All subfields of medical image analysis, such as classification finds a greater acceptability for Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), since it offers flexible finding of the instances based on the input query. The issues with CNN owing to limited labels and scarce data are solved by employing CNN. In this paper, we develop an increased processing CNN design are opening the door to better results for massive datasets. The classification of images required the utilisation of the three fully connected layers to retrieve features. The architecture for medical image retrieval was put to the test using widely known measures such as precision and recall. This success would lead to better computer-aided detection and diagnosis systems in the long run.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Types of Inverters for Low Power at 45nm
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: VLSI is an evergreen field that is constantly expanding. To fit more gates on a given chip area, a significant amount of work is required. As a result, removing the heat generated is difficult. Using low-power circuits, this problem can be solved. In today’s electronics industry, a low power requirement has become a primary goal. In the design of VLSI chips, power dissipation has become as critical as performance and size. Low-power chip requirements are becoming increasingly important in the VLSI business as chip dimensions shrink and environmental issues become more important. Because of the requirement to low package cost and increase battery life, power optimization is as critical as time for many systems. In the past, the total power dissipation of CMOS devices was dominated by dynamic power. This paper discusses CMOS, lector, forced NMOS, forced 2 NMOS, forced PMOS as approaches for reducing power requirements at various stages of CMOS architecture. The results are examined at various supply voltages while maintaining the load capacitance (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">load</inf> = 500fF) which include power, delay, switching threshold voltage, noise margin, the inverter utilizing forced NMOS technology is considered good because the noise margin obtained is the highest here, 2.48V evaluated at 4.02V supply voltage. When all other factors are equal, the inverter adopting the lector approach consumes less power than the other inverters at all supply voltages.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review & Design of Web-Based Blood Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blood is a fluid that carries oxygen and is a connective tissue that carries other substances because of its volume. Now that we understand the importance of blood, we see that it not only carries oxygen to the tissues but also clears the air between them through the heart and blood vessels. The average volume of blood donation is 470ml per person, which is only 8% of the adult volume. When blood is needed in a hospital, it is usually not available in time, leading to inconsistencies. Both patients and sponsors are unaware that the donor is being hospitalized due to a lack of communication and other services. A system like this is needed to close the communication gap between hospitals, blood banks, donors, and receptors. The main purpose of a web-based blood donation program is to ensure compliance with blood stock. In today's system, first and foremost the hand system, and when a person needs a blood type and that type is not available in that blood bank, it takes time to process blood from another blood bank, which may adversely affect the patient's health because time is critical in emergencies. Therefore, a web-based blood donation system is a good place to monitor whether a particular type of blood is available in a stack or not, as well as to provide a place where blood can be accessed.

articleTitle: Review on Hotel Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With India’s rapid economic and tourism development, competition in the hotel industry has intensified. Only to improve their management methods and practices and to improve the quality of their work on a regular basis, they can also get enough healthy growth. Therefore, the operation of the hotel computer management has become a very important task. These articles give a brief introduction of a hotel management system, based on software engineering methods to perform performance analysis, needs analysis and design. The whole system is divided into separate modules and introduces the function, while providing a set of conditions and logical structure of data management database. These analyses and guidelines basically meet the structure hotel management requirements based on information technology, to improve the quality of service and efficiency of hotel managers.

articleTitle: Design of a Quad-Band 6CB Nematic Phase Liquid Crystal Antenna for Commercial Wi-MAX and WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A Quad-band 6CB nematic phase liquid crystal antenna for commercial Wi-MAX and WLAN applications have been developed in present work. Now a day’s multiple bands working antennas become very useful in wireless communication applications. To achieve the multiple bands substrate with proper dielectric constant and structure of the patch plays major role. In this present work glass substrate with 6.438 dielectric constant have been taken for achieving the desired band of applications. Two glass substrates with the size of 21x25mm2 and 19x19mm2 have been taken with the gap of 0.005mm is taken to fill the LC (liquid crystal). The patch of proposed design is triple fork shaped, which is achieved by modifying the standard rectangular patch. Proposed antenna is having full ground at back side of the substrate and both ground and patch are connected through SMA connector for excitation of antenna. The designed antenna is having quad band features, operating at the range of 2.57-3.14GHz, 3.47- 3.84GHz,4.73-5.19GHz, and 5.89-6.46GHz respectively. The resonant frequencies of the designed antenna are 2.88GHz,3.66GHz,4.94GHz and 6.2GHz, which includes the commercial WLAN and Wi-MAX applications respectively.

articleTitle: Building Extraction using SLIC from High Resolution Satellite Image
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Data extraction has always been a priority for any company or government agency in satellite imagery. This release of Data in the form of architecture from satellite imagery has played a very important role in the military, national security, agriculture, and understanding of global geography. It is a field of ongoing research into computer vision and remote hearing. In this paper we present the default model for creating automated method of extracting buildings structures from a high-resolution satellite image using deep learning and segmentation. Here, we perform a separate segmentation using the SLIC algorithm. Segmenting the image before training increase accuracy and efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Four OTA-Based Mixed-Mode Filter Configuration And Quadrature Voltage Mode Sinusoidal Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Operational transconductance amplifiers (OTAs) based mixed-mode biquad filter configuration employing four OTAs has been presented in this paper. The circuit utilizes canonic number of grounded capacitors (02), which is eminently suitable for IC fabrication. The proposed biquad structure has orthogonal tunability of pole frequency (ω), pole quality factor (Q) and bandwidth (BW). A sinusoidal oscillator with quadrature outputs is also realizable from the voltage mode filter topology with electronic adjustment of condition of oscillation (CO) and frequency of oscillation (FO). Various simulation results using CMOS OTA with 0:18µm CMOS technology parameters have been included to confirm the validity of the presented circuits.

articleTitle: An IoT based Solution to Prevent the Spreading of COVID-19 by Contactless Temperature Sensing and Social Distance Alerting System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The current situation we are now facing in fact the whole world facing is the pandemic COVID19. In prior observing its symptoms, the only possible way is to check the temperature of a person, and this should also be done by following the rules of social distancing. To make this possible we came to an idea called contactless Temperature sensing. This helps in automatic the thing in sensing the temperature. This is a sophisticated way in checking the person’s body temperature. The detailed information of the body temperature and the distance of a person from the sensor will be displayed in a smartphone so there will be no need for any to be there to make sure of temperature. A lot has been talked about temperature, but what about the distancing of the people? This will be taken care by the sensor called ultrasonic sensor we used. This helps in keep distancing the people and keeps a track of the distance. This can be implemented Infront of gates of a hotel or maybe somewhere the crowd will be more. This helps the guard to make themselves fee safe to make sure of every person's temperature, and their traces. This idea will also help many of us. The idea that we propose will also make everyone feel safe, rich user experience and a well good administration of temperature checking.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection using Hybrid of Deep Neural Network and Stacked LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Fake News is one of the major concerns for the world and it could cause many problems like misleading people, the potential to influence people’s opinions, etc. Hence distinguishing fake news is very crucial. Fake news can be detected using artificial intelligence methodologies using a title, body of the news, and other attributes such as credibility of the authors, location, media such as images, audio, and video, etc. In this paper, a hybrid of deep neural networks and stacked LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) is used to detect fake news. We used Glove 300d as a word embedding layer and implemented the concept of stacked LSTM. The model has been applied to two different datasets. The results are compared with previous models and have found with good performance in comparison to the selected previously existing models.

articleTitle: Analysing Schedulers of Multipath TCP in Diverse Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Multipath TCP (MPTCP) is made up of many TCP connections as individual sub-flow. It is implemented in the Linux kernel and derived from TCP. MPTCP has two control planes, data identified by data sequence number and connection identified by sub-flow sequence number. MPTCP transfers data using multiple sub-flows concurrently. This paper compares known schedulers of MPTCP with respect to throughput, download time, RTT, and bandwidth utilization parameters in a dynamic network environment.

articleTitle: An Analysis and Research on Sentiments of Twitter Data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays social networking or we can say that social media becomes the main source of gathering information all around the world. We are able to know opinions of public and from that we can generate sentiments of that topics. So in this regard we can say that sentiment analysis is a technology and a method to analyze the sentiments of a topic and which predicts that a piece of writing indicates a positive, negative and neutral sentiment and nature on the topic. In this project or paper, we can talk about twitter which is the most famous platform where people can add their tweets and opinions and share their ideas as by posting tweets. The study mainly have a look on sentiment or centers around assessments of information of twitter data that’s why this project is all about twitter sentiment analysis. The main work of project or this research paper is all about making a suitable program that knows and analyze the sentiments of tweets. Here the process of analyzing sentiments becomes the most important part for main applications and the people who trying to find out response in field of market, political elections. The aim is just to develop a function which tells automatic sentiment classification of daily tweets.

articleTitle: IoT and Fog Enabled Model for Saffron Cultivation in Precision Farming
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the increase in the number of smart devices, there will be rapid growth of data storage issues and also data processing speed will not match effectively with the requirements of a centralized cloud server repository. Mission-critical and sensitive applications like aircraft operations and control systems, online banking systems will need minimum latency and quick response time. To address these issues and provide cloud services available to the proximity of edge users without causing delays (like processing delays, network delays, etc.), the concept of fog computing came into existence. Fog computing makes real-time data available to mobile users without any delays close to the edge of the network. With the decline of saffron cultivation in the last decade due to numerous arid and climatic challenges, the Internet of Things (IoT) seems to be an impeccable solution for its cultivation. In this research contribution, a fog-assisted information model for saffron cultivation has been proposed which delivers information to all saffron cultivators as a cloud service using IoT and fog, thus eradicating the possibilities of latency and storage issues. Also, the services offered by the fog node using the ESP32 Wi-Fi module are discussed. To implement the proposed model, data gathered from sensor nodes is stored on the cloud and big data analytics is performed on collected data. Simultaneously, machine learning technology will be used to facilitate increased crop yield in making proper decisions for all the saffron cultivators in smart farming. The decline in research trends in the last decade using various parameters has also been presented.

articleTitle: End-to-End Encryption for Chat App with Dynamic Encryption Key
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With millions of users’ End-to-End encryption has been converted into an ordinary characteristic in popular mobile chat relevance’s (apps). Most imperative chat apps have added end-to-end encryption characteristics in the two years, several mutually with Facebook Messenger, and What’s App. This paper illustrates how dissimilar concerns in an app can add up to the probable for severe vectors adjacent to end-to-end solitude despite their creature several layers of security. To overcome the app is anticipated in the chats are secured by the dynamic key encryption by md5 algorithm. Only user 1 and user 2 are going to know the message this secures the chats from unwanted users. In the middle attacker and server, those who are trying to attack will get to know the garbage value of message. The XOR operation is used for encrypting the message and to provide security for user1 and user2 of the message. The md5 is utilized as key the key is engendered for every message by three parameters and this gives next altitude of security to the chat app. If the key is hacked by the attacker, the second key for the message is tricky to hack this augment the involvedness of the app and secures much more. In exacting, the app illustrates how a dynamic key is utilized for encryption which protects the message with facilitate of a dynamic key. It secures the chat app by generating the key dynamically.

articleTitle: Online Collaborative Text Editor Using Socket.IO
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: One of difficulties when we work in group is to team up in a proficient manner. Additionally, working from distance with a group is a bad dream particularly when wemake a report and conceptualizing thoughts. From this point of view, making a constant shared word processor was conceived. In this position paper we contend for working from a training- based viewpoint when going up against issues of shared altering. In this paper, we present Fresh Edit, an online, open- source, community text comment instrument using Socket.IO.

articleTitle: Implementation and Performance Analysis of 2:1 Multiplexer using Different Logic Families at 130nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Multiplexer (MUX) which is also familiar as an input or information selector and a device that opts joining different analog or digital signal inputs and ahead the marked put in to sole yield. It is first of the salient components which upgrade the effectiveness of data transversal. Multiplexers are used to expand the amount of the data that can transferred over a line of network with given bandwidth over a time of period. There are different multiplexers for digital and analog signals. A digital multiplexer has digital input signals coming from different data-acquisition networks. In this project, a 2:1 multiplexer is analyzed by numerous CMOS logics which are Pseudo NMOS logic, Static CMOS logic, Dual-Rail Domino logic and Domino logic which recognize the foremost families that is appropriate for the outline of greatest methods of multiplexer. The execution is implemented in VLSI automation because it have characteristics such as less size, less cost, great operating speed and less power. The accomplishment research of the multiplexer using different logic families are executed in DSCH, Micro wind and Mentor graphics at 130nm.The results gathered shows that the Domino logic method based 2:1 multiplexer is the well-organized method. The Domino logic outshines the different logics that the work recommends that the giant elevated different level multiplexer with shallow power and power delay product can be accomplished using method of Domino logic.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Student Performance Using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper presents a new approach based on fuzzy reasoning; logic in order to have a better evaluation of the student's school or college. The ability to predict the performance of the students is an important issue for both the students and the university. A more appropriate and accurate assessment, it helps to have a better understanding of the necessary education and training to the students which helps the students to get a better performance, not only academic, but also in other areas of life. In this system, fuzzy logic, this means that the student takes the assessment; the performance should be a reasonable and acceptable performance in front of him. The previous methods that can be used to estimate only the most recent data available, that is, the prediction was not accurate, it is compared with the fuzzy logic approach. In the present system, the fuzzy logic is good enough to be dominated by the old ways. This paper describes a new approach for the prediction of the normal learning process and the learner's behavior, which can be easily accessible and easy to interpret.

articleTitle: Machine Leaning Models Comparison for Sales Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Businesses around the world run to achieve there objectives and one of the major objective of any business to expand in the market and with that also increase there profitability. For a business to reach there goals they maintain records of different aspects of there business so that they can optimise there business not just with their will and choices but also based on what they have done before and what were the results of those tasks. Conglomerates and Enterprises invest a lot in SAP so as to keep track of each and everything of their businesses so as to maximise profit and market share. As per the rise in technology there have been multiple astonishing ways in the field of Artificial Intelligence to do all these stuff using different Machine Learning models. But with a lot of technologies there comes an Anomaly of choice that which one should be preferred. Our paper focusses on which machine learning model is the most accurate when it comes to predicting sales for any business , as every business have different variety of customers with different taste of products but for a business to achieve its goal it is important for it to focus more on fast selling products in comparison with focussing on slow selling products.In this paper we are comparing 5 machine learning models namely Linear Regression , ARIMA , XGBoost , Long Short Term Memory Model and Random Forest Regression.

articleTitle: IoT Based Irrigation System -A Farmer Friendly Version
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: India is an agrarian nation that hugely depends on the agriculture and its related products. Nevertheless, the population of India is increasing at a very high rate. Until 2035, India may surpass china's population and become the most populous country/nation in the world. This is a concerning matter as India is still a developing nation, and if India's population continues to increase at this rate, sooner or later, there will be a scarcity of food and water. So we need a better farming and irrigation technology than the conventional farming and irrigation systems like dribble watering, drip watering frameworks, canal irrigation, or the dekhli irrigation, which are the most labor-intensive and time-consuming irrigation systems .and waste much water. This paper aims to introduce a modern but farmer-friendly watering framework that saves water and is easy to use for the average farmer of India. Technology is of no value if it is not understandable by the standard user; in this case, the standard user is farmers. This system uses an Arduino UNO as its microcontroller with a gsm 900 module to communicate with the farmer even on the 2g phone. This automated system automatically detects the soil's drought or wet condition do the needful irrigation and sends a message to the farmer about the condition so that farmer can monitor the farm even without being physically present.

articleTitle: Centralized Air Purification System Using Ai
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A lot of inventions have been made to maintain the air quality index of the surrounding both for indoors and outdoors such as air purifiers and filters, but they somehow require human intervention. This has increased the demand of a smart and automatic system which is capable of providing clean air. To do so, we are designing a "Centralized Air Purification System". This system uses machine learning technology. The system will firstly monitor the occupancy in the room if there will be presence of someone, air quality will be monitored. In case the air quality index is above 100, the process of air purification will start. This system is worth because it is an automatic, efficient and advanced air purification system which will be useful for our homes.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Aadhaar Authentication Process and Way Forward
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Aadhaar, India’s indigenous digital identity program, has already covered more than 90% of the residents of India by issuing more than 1.30 billion Aadhaar numbers by 15th Oct 2021 and is set to achieve the global strategic goal (SDG 16.9) as defined in the UN Sustainable Development Goals of providing legal identification for all by 2030 in near future. Aadhaar is the world’s largest identity project which aims to provide unique identity to all the residents of India. A number of government social welfare schemes are using Aadhaar as a means of identification of beneficiaries for disbursement of services, and increasingly, a host of private sector entities such as banks etc. are also using Aadhaar. The number of Aadhaar based transactions is more than 40 million per day and is likely to increase exponentially, however many cases of frauds taking place in Aadhaar authentication are also being reported in media. This technology assessment focuses on analyzing the security problems associated with Aadhaar authentication process and various mitigation steps taken to minimize frauds. This paper concludes by providing recommendations to minimize the security risks and frauds in Aadhaar authentication.

articleTitle: Smart Integration of Home Automation and Uninterruptible Power Supply for Low Power Household Appliances
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper mainly describes the design of an LED emergency lamp based on online UPS configuration where when the main power is out, it immediately turns on. The LED is powered by a battery that continues to charge when the main power is turned on. The autonomous LED lamp’s circuit is created and simulated before being manufactured incorporating hardware. The system is designed along with additional features of automation using Arduino and IoT techniques. The ease and flexibility available to consumers is the driving force behind developing a system capable of wireless communication through Bluetooth.

articleTitle: Securing of Cloud Infrastructure using Enterprise Honeypot
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: An enterprise honeypot is developed to protect virtual machines (VMs) in Cloud Infrastructure (ICI). A Honeyed honeypot with Snort is integrated to identify hidden security flaws and to prevent internal intrusions or attackers from exploiting these vulnerabilities. This company's honeypot prevents MCs and does a profound study of the activity of the invader in the private cloud. The experimental findings demonstrate that enterprise honeypot has been implemented successfully in ICI and illustrate its strength in security threats. The information collected by snort is helpful for the behavior of the invader. There have been two main findings. First, ICI must secure VMs from internal intruders. Second, the infrastructure of the Cloud needs to be safer. The results show that more effective security warnings may be created to improve security.

articleTitle: Big Data and Machine Learning in Healthcare: Tools & Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Normally healthcare is said to be information rich and to extract hidden data from such information-rich industry is difficult. It becomes necessary for healthcare informatics to deal with the advancement in technology and big data. This can be done by changing three core areas namely, to manage record electronically, integrate big data and computer-aided diagnosis. To resolve the mentioned challenges machine learning provides a range of techniques, algorithm, and different frameworks. This paper focuses on handling big data of health care to predict disease using machine leaning approaches.

articleTitle: Identifying and Analyze the Face Mask Detection for The Person During Covid
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In December 2019, a disease known as COVID-19 outbroke in some part of China which killed a bunch of people in that area. Till Mid-March, the disease spread all over the world killing more people. Due to this, World Health Organization (WHO) had to declare this decease as a pandemic. Therefore, scientists from all over the world were working very hard, giving their best everyday in order to make an anti-dote of this disease but it was expected to take alot of time and it even took. Now, government allowed the citizens to continue their normal way of living but still they made some protocols which was to be followed such as sanitization of hands on a regular interval, maintaining two-yard distance from each other, wearing masks, etc. Considering those protocols, we have evolved a Face-masks Detection System with a view to be useful in figuring out whether or not a person is wearing a mask or not inside the public locations which include Temples, Airports, and so on. The face masks detection database contains a mask and further to the facial snap shots, we've used OpenCV to carry out actual-time face detection from live streaming thru webcam. We have used the database to create a COVID-19 face mask detector from a computer view the use of Python, OpenCV, and Tensor Flow and Cameras. We present an in-intensity reading software that could come across conditions where a face mask isn't always used well. Our software incorporates a two-section configuration of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that could hit upon hidden and unidentified faces and may point-out with pre-hooked up CCTV cameras. This allows in monitoring safety violations, promote using face mask, and ensures a safe running environment.

articleTitle: OpenApi Workflows for Model and Format Conversion of Machine Learning Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Various machine learning frameworks have their format in which they accept the model. ONNX is an open format. These models are the representation of the neural network with weights after training. A model created for a particular framework has to be converted into a different format as required for use with another framework So, this paper deals with the design of such conversion tools. Our paper mainly deals with the design of conversion tools of 4 popular frameworks of machine learning that is Keras, ONNX, Tensorflow Lite, and Pytorch. Moreover, we have also created the Open API-based workflow model. So, the users can be able to pipeline our project with another language also since the API became language agonistic. We have also created a private API using Flask.

articleTitle: A Literature Review of Challenges in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Internet has become the most important part of our life. It helps in doing our household, office works, entertainment, traveling, farming, and many more. For making a connection among all these fields, we require a network through which everything can be connected. The internet is one of the networks, which help in doing this connection and communication. That connection makes a new term, "Internet of Things." It contains various components with different features. That is one of the challenges of IoT, except for this challenge there are many more challenges are present. In this network, our data move wirelessly from one place to another. That makes our data a little insecure. Insecurity creates many issues, security issues. IoT network also uses sensors that are low powered. For transferring messages from one sensor to another, we require energy- efficient routing protocols. So, in this paper, we have discussed the challenges and security issues that are mentioned by different researchers.

articleTitle: Automatic Billing System using Resnet and Image AI
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this age of automation, industries are trying to modernize their infrastructure by installing robotic and automated machineries in their stores and workshops. This is done in order to reduce the cost of manufacturing a product, speeding up the process and making the industry less dependent on manual labor. In retail stores and shopping malls, customers have to wait in line at the billing counter for the receipt of the items which they brought. This is due to the inefficiency of the human worker who enters the details of the product and makes bill. This is a time consuming process. To make it more efficient we propose an automated billing system which can calculate the total billing amount of the items brought without any help of cloud serves and internet. We use the concept of edge computing to make our system less dependent on internet and more dependent on local machines. We use the techniques of image classification like residual network and ImageAI to identify the product with different dimensions and color.

articleTitle: Live Object Detection in Real Time
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: While deep learning has achieved excellent results for the discovery of articles, there have been numerous issues identified with certifiable images such as clamor, obscuration, turning jitter, and so forth. These issues have a significant effect on the discovery of articles. The primary objective of this investigation is the identification of objects based on the You Only Look Once (YOLO) method. This method has a few advantages over other methods of determining article location. As YOLO anticipates jumping boxes using convolutional neural networks, a calculation made with difference algorithms, such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Fast-Convolutional Neural Network, does not consider the whole picture. We have used this calculation to identify different kinds of items.

articleTitle: Low-Frequency Ultrasound Therapeutic Device For Soft Tissue Healing
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Soft tissues are the dense fibrous connective tissues that include tendons ligaments, fascia, and muscles that connect and support the organ of the body. Tendons and ligaments are mostly subjected to injuries in sports person and person who regularly practicing exercise that may lead to tendon and ligament rupture which limit the activities of daily living. Collagen bundles in the muscles heal tendon injury as early as possible if the injury is not chronic. To treat such chronic injuries, physiotherapy and surgery are followed in the field of orthopedics, where patients may have some discomforts physically as well as mentally. In emerging medical techniques, ultrasound paves the way to treat chronic soft tissue injuries. Collagen fibers with good strength help in the movement of soft tissues. When soft tissues got injured, collagen bundles alignment is adversely affected and leads to movement disorders permanently in serious cases. Most therapeutic devices use MHz of frequency, which fails to treat injury completely. To serve this purpose, a low-cost and lightweight therapeutic device was designed to generate a low frequency of ultrasound of 250KHz can be liable to realign the collagen bundles effectively. It had been proved that low frequency can leads to higher penetration into tissues. Thus, this device can penetrate deeper into the tendon and can realign collagen bundles effectively.

articleTitle: Attendance Management System Using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper we are going to discuss and understand the whole scenario that how we can implement the face recognition to take or mark attendance without any failure, if we talk about the attendance system very first its come to pen paper mode in this mode any teacher have to maintain a lot of thing in his register and its not too much efficient and chances of proxy is too high, so to overcome from old days to modern days we will bring a new concept which is too efficient and can too task in very less time with less effort and also have good accuracy. e.g. school, collage. etc.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Aircraft Wing Angles Estmation Using Python Tool
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The wing is a superstructure that can fly thanks to an airfoil profile that generates lift from the forward motion of the vehicle. There are two ends of the cantilever structure on fixed-wing aircraft: one is let free and the other is fixed. In this article, CREO is used to simulate the precise structure of an Aeroplan wing with a winglet. Once the wing structure has been analyzed, pressure analysis of the wing's structure is carried out. An ANSYS model is used to determine the winglet's safety factor using a restricted component method with the help of ANSYS. There must be an exhaustion damage aggregation modeling, constant abundance of S-N (stress life) information for various pressure proportions, and the stress history of the neighborhood at the pressure focus in order for the safety factor to be effective. The aircraft wing with winglets (450 and 250 points) is examined in this theory. The winglet points (450 and 250) are subjected to a static and fatigue research in order to determine the load and life of the winglet due to the applied weight loading. At 250winglet is performing well and getting expected results. This entire work is estimated in python tool 3.6.8 version.

articleTitle: Various Applications of Artificial Neural Network and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Neural Network is used in various applications like extraction of information, generation of language, text classification, recognition of speech and characters and many more. But there are certain limitations also such as time consumed, large structure, unexplained functions, and number of epochs. The number of epochs and time can be reduced by using neural network with wavelet transform. By implementing these two techniques together, the number of epoch can be minimized to a greater extend and with which less time is consumed. In this paper, such applications are discussed in which ANN-WT (Artificial Neural Network- Wavelet Transform) was implemented and showed better results.

articleTitle: Intelligent Health Monitoring System for Infants
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s life we can see that the number of working women increased very much. So that there is a very big problem for them for carrying of their small babies. Because of that most of the parents need to send their babies to baby care house or grandparent house. However, after that also parents are unable to see the live condition of their babies. Therefore intelligent health monitoring system is proposed as a low cost and efficient Internet of things based system for real time monitoring. In the proposed system we are using Node Micro-Controller Unit (NodeMCU) Controller Board which gathers the data and information recorded by the sensors and uploads its using the Wi-Fi to the AdaFruit MQTT server. It also contains different types of sensors like as temperature sensor to sense the temperature and according to room temperature the fan which is on the upper side of the baby cradle run accordingly .heart beat sensor is also there to the heart beat , bp sensor is attached in the side part of baby cradle and in touch with the body of the baby to measure the bp .we have also introduced the sound sensor there to know whether the baby is crying or not. Infrared temperature sensors -thermopiles is also there to measure the body temperature .we have also introduced wireless security camera to know the live condition of the baby which is connected to the MCQTT server which is a mobile application by which we can see the live video and photos on the mobile screen.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Dengue Outbreak
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Dengue, well known as a deadly mosquito disease, is speedily spreading around the globe. The transmission cycle of Dengue virus is highly supported by the Temperature, Relative Humidity and Rainfall conditions as these factors promote its growth and habitat. Till date, there is no vaccination or medication available for Dengue fever. In lack of medical support, the only way to prevent Dengue is by controlling the spread of its vector. In this study, a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) is proposed for Dengue outbreak prediction taking into account the data set of previous 10 years. It elaborates the firm relationship of the Dengue outbreak and meteorological factors. The results obtained from the model predicts the outbreak with accuracy of approx- imately 93.38%.This model can be successfully implemented for control and prevention of dengue outbreak.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Insight on Machine Learning Enabled Internet of Things Recommender Systems (IoTRS)
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the advancement in technologies, the opportunities for new integrated solutions are also unlocked. Internet of Things by connecting cyber and physical world introduce enormous paradigm change in computing and information technologies. Recommender system helps in filtering the data by taking care of inclinations of users to prevail the issues related to overdosing of IoT generated data. Machine learning techniques can be applied for producing intelligent recommendation by exploiting IoT-based dynamic, scalable and heterogeneous data. This paper reviews the machine learning techniques applied for generating personalized recommendation in IoT-based services and give the brief introduction of IoT recommender systems and machine learning techniques. Personalization and recommendations services in different application domains are enhanced by the incorporation of machine learning algorithms. In IoT recommendations machine learning also leaving their remarkable presence with integrating automaticity and dynamicity.

articleTitle: Line Follower Robot with Obstacle Avoiding Module
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
