abstract: The line robot which we are trying to make is a robot which can sense a line(usually black) with the help of its IR sensors and walk on the path which is to be made by the line which can be modified by the user to get his work done with the help of the robot. It does so with the help of the microcontroller board by arduino which is arduino UNO which will be more than sufficient for our project. The microcontroller (Arduino UNO) inputs the signal from the IR sensor and then analysis the signal and give instructions to its dc motors whether to start the left motor or right motor or both of them. We will also introduce an ultrasonic sound sensor which would be used to detect the obstacles and change its path and get back to its line again. There will be 3 IR sensors for the line follower robot to be more accurate. The centre IR sensor will be on the black line and whenever there is a left turn, the left sensor will be on the black line and the left motor will stop and right one will move the robot towards the left and similar would be the working for a right turn. Whenever all the three sensors of the robot will sense the black line the robot will stop.

articleTitle: Location Based Events Management System Using Ensemble Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Now a day’s events are becoming core and important part of life. According to surveys, events are planned according to the management in an accurate time. But still, some ensemble techniques are used according to the learning patterns, sensor data is mostly used in high-level activity inference. There are some labeled person’s activities for significant places that are used as traces in GPS data. In contrast with ensemble learning techniques, this approach is constantly detecting and classifying some significant locations. This system uses Markov relational networks in a hierarchical model that performs some encoding operations in complex GPS readings. There are various deep learning architectures that are designed for various tasks that are performed in the past few decades. At present this research ensemble deep learning frameworks to decrease the issues of overfitting caused in single models.Through learning patterns, the analysis of the algorithms can be done that are applied for this research. The system contains Markov relational networks to implement the hierarchical activities which need to encode the complex relations. In recent researches, some experiments have shown some improvements in the latest techniques that are implemented. Some issues in this are not solved. The first issue is that work is decoupled this shows issues to determine the locations. This issue is simply handled by assuming the location but in some ways, locations are recorded for the user who is using this system. It also contains a lower threshold; some of it contains too many locations that are significant.The second concern is about computational efficiency that prevents the approaches from tackling event activities. It cannot differentiate between the events and places. There are no modular approaches that represented the activities.

articleTitle: An Organizational Structure for Sustainable Software Development
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Over decades, the amount of electronic waste generated, energy consumption, and other environmentally harmful processes in engineering have contributed to the degradation of the environment. It is necessary for companies to keep a track of their power management as the first step towards reducing their carbon footprint. Greening of software plays a key role in power management in companies. This study highlights the importance of green software and how professionals perceive it. It further goes on to discuss and explain existing green software and current methods adopted by organizations for making the software development life cycle energy efficient. A comparative study of these methods is provided. Finally, the paper proposes an organizational structure to incorporate sustainability at every step of the software development process.

articleTitle: Stareview Review Management
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Reviews are the backbone for every growing industry, To manage reviews and keeping track of records can be a overwhelming task. Managing performance of individuals can be a task to tackle, and improving the respective performances can be managed when there is a dedicated business tool for it. Having good management of reviews and ratings for products and individuals and by analyzing pros and cons can surely services in future. During this research, we kept in mind to manage all this and automate things as much as possible, we analyzed sentiments of reviews for staff for some statistical data for each individual and made a review management application that are portrayed within the later a component of paper. NLP models have been measured by criterion like confusion matrices and a easy to use web application has been implemented for convenient uses

articleTitle: Voice Recognised Home Automation System Using IoT-Physically Challenged People
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Home Automation System is getting progressively mainstream because of its various benefits. The Arduino Nano (main) controller) is responsible for processing and transmitting the entry records. The Internet of Things (IoT) provides a massive storage facility for data series from sensors and domestic home appliances. An Android utility has been developed to reveal the house's surroundings and remotely manipulate the house's gadgets via the use of a button or voice. This mission's speaker-independent popular machine enables physically challenged humans to manipulate electrical home equipment without moving. All records are saved on Firebase and can be retrieved using the utility at any time. A faceted view of a prototype version with glazing and four domestic regions is provided. As a result of this investigation, the after-effects on the clients' well-being, security, insight, and comfort are promising. Results: Several sensors and actuators were linked to the Arduino, which updated the data for the IoT worker. Workstations/PCs can be used to validate the sensor data. Voice commands can be used to control home appliances effectively and productively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Covid – 19 Detection System Using Chest X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Coronavirus, a lung infection disease 2019 (COVID-19), is a sickness that is happening because of a virus, which is now also known as SARS-CoV-2 (Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 COVID) was initially found in the city of China, named Wuhan. WHO was reported about COVID-19 disease on December 31st, year 2019.On January 30th, 2020, the WHO declared this outbreak a health emergency on a global level. On March 11th, 2020, it was announced as a worldwide pandemic by the World Health Organization. Coronavirus can trigger a tract infection. It affects a human being's respiratory tract-both lower or upper or both. In this research, we have proposed a rapid detection system for noticing COVID 19 disease in its early stages by using images of radiography(chest). Our model differentiates between two types of images, standard (non-COVID) and COVID infected. Since the images used for the training part for COVID infection are limited, we have used the Data Augmentation technique. Data Augmentation is a phenomenon that expands the dimensions of a dataset by producing altered versions of these images. This approach has proved to increase the efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Various Aspects of Software Fault Prediction: A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the domain of software engineering, software fault prediction is a prominent research area. To enhance the quality of software, software fault prediction is introduced. The primary intention of software fault prediction is to search for faults in the earlier stages of software development to minimize the risk of software failure in the future. However, testing is also used to find the faults in the software, but software fault prediction consumes fewer resources and time. There are mainly three aspects of software fault prediction: data sets, metrics, modeling techniques, and performance measures. This paper reviews different aspects of software fault prediction such as metrics and modeling techniques. The survey is summarized in the form of tables. At last, conclusion is discussed.

articleTitle: An Approach To Secure Sensitive Attributes Stored On HDFS Using Blowfish
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: These days security is important while storing our sensitive data in PC or over the web. Hadoop is a distributed data storage and analysis framework. Organizations store sensitive data on HDFS and analyse the data using MapReduce. As a result, data encryption is frequently employed to prevent the leakage of important information. Our research work find the sensitive attributes from the file stored in HDFS , then symmetric encryption scheme BlowFish is applied on sensitive attributes only and whole file stored in HDFS to find the comparison. The sensitive attributes encryption/decryption is found to be much better than the whole file encryption/decryption in terms of performance evaluation. To validate the capabilities, different file sizes are used and certain experimental studies are conducted. Since Hadoop lacks in customized encryption, proposed approach will definitely enhance the performance in better way.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis between Traditional learning and Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In modern days, Artificial intelligence is gaining popularity due to use in smart technology. For making system more intelligent machine learning and deep learning approaches are performed well in research fields. Traditional learning is sub sphere of artificial intelligence and deep learning lies under the Traditional learning, these approaches are performed robustly in solving real life complex problems with more accuracy. This paper primarily focuses on comparative analysis among traditional learning and deep learning approaches. Considering comparative analysis following parameters have been taken under consideration amount of data, features, time, accuracy, debugging, expensive and decision path.
